examples.en: Their friendship started when they were at school.
examples.zh: 他们的友谊始于上学时。

examples.en: He finds it hard to make new friendships.
examples.zh: 他觉得交新朋友很难。

examples.en: From that meeting, they built a lifelong friendship.
examples.zh: 从那次见面起，他们建立了终生的友谊。

examples.en: She is always honest with her friends.
examples.zh: 她对朋友总是很诚实。

examples.en: Please give me an honest answer to my question.
examples.zh: 请诚实地回答我的问题。

examples.en: He has an honest face, so people trust him.
examples.zh: 他长着一张诚实的脸，所以人们信任他。

examples.en: He is often very cheerful.
examples.zh: 他经常非常快乐。

examples.en: You look cheerful this morning.
examples.zh: 你今天早上看起来很快乐。

examples.en: She stays cheerful even in hard times.
examples.zh: 即使在困难时期她也保持乐观。

examples.en: Her new book is a humorous look at teen life.
examples.zh: 她的新书幽默地展现了青少年生活。

examples.en: She told me a humorous story about Max.
examples.zh: 她给我讲了一个关于马克斯的幽默故事。

examples.en: I gave her an article that I thought was humorous.
examples.zh: 我给了她一篇文章，我觉得那篇文章很幽默。

examples.en: I always think Jo is a very caring person.
examples.zh: 我一直觉得乔是个非常关心他人的人。

examples.en: You will never meet a person more caring than her.
examples.zh: 你永远不会遇到比她更体贴的人。

examples.en: He is a nice guy and very caring.
examples.zh: 他是个好人，而且很关心别人。

examples.en: There seems to be some truth in her words.
examples.zh: 她的话里似乎有一些事实。

examples.en: There is no truth in the news about his leaving.
examples.zh: 关于他离开的消息没有事实依据。

examples.en: You can't question the truth of his story.
examples.zh: 你不能质疑他所说故事的事实性。

examples.en: Did I tell you the joke about the chicken?
examples.zh: 我跟你讲过那个关于鸡的笑话吗？

examples.en: She cracked jokes and told funny stories all evening.
examples.zh: 她整个晚上都在讲笑话和有趣的故事。

examples.en: She tied his shoelaces together for a joke.
examples.zh: 她开玩笑把他的鞋带系在了一起。

examples.en: They laughed at her funny stories.
examples.zh: 他们听了她有趣的故事笑了起来。

examples.en: I couldn't stop laughing at the movie.
examples.zh: 看那部电影时我忍不住一直笑。

examples.en: He laughed nervously before his speech.
examples.zh: 演讲前他紧张地笑了笑。

examples.en: This magazine is very popular with teenagers.
examples.zh: 这本杂志很受青少年欢迎。

examples.en: As a teenager, he dyed his hair pink.
examples.zh: 他青少年时把头发染成了粉色。

examples.en: The teenager often made her mother angry.
examples.zh: 那个青少年经常惹妈妈生气。

examples.en: Bad weather can make anyone unhappy.
examples.zh: 坏天气能让任何人感到不开心。

examples.en: Their marriage was unhappy from the start.
examples.zh: 他们的婚姻从一开始就不幸福。

examples.en: She was unhappy with the hotel room.
examples.zh: 她对酒店房间不满意。

examples.en: Don't lie in bed all day.
examples.zh: 别整天躺在床上。

examples.en: They lie on the beach in summer.
examples.zh: 他们夏天躺在沙滩上。

examples.en: Lie on your side and rest.
examples.zh: 侧躺着休息一下。

examples.en: Who was the first person to swim across the sea?
examples.zh: 谁是第一个游过这片海的人？

examples.en: A dinner for two persons is about $70 at that place.
examples.zh: 在那个地方，两个人吃一顿晚餐大约要70美元。

examples.en: Four persons were charged with the murder.
examples.zh: 四个人被指控犯有谋杀罪。

examples.en: Please ask me again tomorrow. I need to give it some thought.
examples.zh: 请明天再问我一次。我需要考虑一下。

examples.en: She never gives thought to how she looks.
examples.zh: 她从不考虑自己的外表。

examples.en: Let me have your thoughts on the report by Friday.
examples.zh: 周五前让我听听你对这份报告的想法。

examples.en: She ties her hair into a ponytail for gym class.
examples.zh: 她上体育课把头发扎成马尾辫。

examples.en: My sister likes to wear a high ponytail to school.
examples.zh: 我姐姐喜欢扎着高马尾去上学。

examples.en: He pulled her ponytail and she got angry.
examples.zh: 他拉了她的马尾辫，她生气了。

examples.en: Chairs, sofas, and benches are all kinds of seats.
examples.zh: 椅子、沙发和长凳都是各种类型的座位。

examples.en: Please come in and take a seat.
examples.zh: 请进来坐下吧。

examples.en: A car has front and back seats.
examples.zh: 汽车有前排和后排座位。

examples.en: Does competing with others make schoolwork more fun for you?
examples.zh: 和别人竞争会让你的学校作业更有趣吗？

examples.en: Do you like to do schoolwork with friends or alone?
examples.zh: 你喜欢和朋友一起做学校作业还是独自做？

examples.en: Good students always finish their schoolwork on time.
examples.zh: 好学生总是按时完成他们的学校作业。

examples.en: The new leader was honest and trustworthy with people.
examples.zh: 这位新领导对人诚实且值得信赖。

examples.en: Please be straight and trustworthy when you talk to her.
examples.zh: 跟她说话时，请直接且值得信赖。

examples.en: He is so sincere and trustworthy that everyone likes him.
examples.zh: 他如此真诚可信，大家都喜欢他。

examples.en: She carefully folded the letter and kept it in her pocket.
examples.zh: 她小心地折好信，放进了口袋里。

examples.en: Please drive carefully on the icy roads.
examples.zh: 请在结冰的路上小心驾驶。

examples.en: Read the instructions on the box carefully.
examples.zh: 仔细阅读盒子上的说明。

examples.en: She said it again, but I still didn't understand.
examples.zh: 她又说了一遍，但我还是没理解。

examples.en: Does anyone here understand Arabic?
examples.zh: 这里有人懂阿拉伯语吗？

examples.en: He called from a noisy place, so I couldn't understand his words.
examples.zh: 他从一个吵闹的地方打来电话，所以我听不清他的话。

examples.en: The glass broke into little bits on the floor.
examples.zh: 玻璃杯碎成了小块，掉在地上。

examples.en: She does a bit of exercise every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上做一点运动。

examples.en: There were bits of paper everywhere on the floor.
examples.zh: 地板上到处都是碎纸片。

examples.en: I am a little bit tired after the long walk.
examples.zh: 走了很长一段路后，我有点儿累。

examples.en: She feels a little bit nervous before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前她感到有点儿紧张。

examples.en: The soup is a little bit salty for me.
examples.zh: 这汤对我来说有点儿咸。

examples.en: Do you know any funny stories?
examples.zh: 你知道什么好笑的故事吗？

examples.en: I don't think Charlie Chaplin is funny.
examples.zh: 我觉得查理·卓别林不好笑。

examples.en: This film is really funny.
examples.zh: 这部电影真的很好笑。

examples.en: Her great sense of smell helped her know if you smoked.
examples.zh: 她敏锐的嗅觉帮助她分辨出你是否抽烟。

examples.en: I have a bad cold, so I lost my sense of taste.
examples.zh: 我得了重感冒，所以失去了味觉。

examples.en: Did you get any sense of their possible reaction?
examples.zh: 你感觉到他们可能会有什么反应了吗？

examples.en: He has a good sense of humour and often makes us laugh.
examples.zh: 他有很好的幽默感，经常逗我们笑。

examples.en: His childish humour is boring and I don't like it.
examples.zh: 他孩子气的幽默很无聊，我不喜欢。

examples.en: His try to be humour was so bad that I felt awkward.
examples.zh: 他试图搞笑的样子太糟糕了，让我觉得尴尬。

examples.en: My dad has a great sense of humour and always makes us laugh.
examples.zh: 我爸爸很有幽默感，总是逗我们笑。

examples.en: A good sense of humour helps you make more friends at school.
examples.zh: 好的幽默感能帮助你在学校交到更多朋友。

examples.en: She showed her sense of humour by telling a funny joke in class.
examples.zh: 她在班上讲了一个有趣的笑话，展现了她的幽默感。

examples.en: The cold, wet day made the children bored.
examples.zh: 寒冷潮湿的天气让孩子们感到无聊。

examples.en: I am getting bored with eating salad every day.
examples.zh: 我每天吃沙拉，开始觉得厌烦了。

examples.en: She was bored of hearing the same song every day.
examples.zh: 她每天听同一首歌，感到很厌烦。

examples.en: She is an energetic young woman.
examples.zh: 她是一个精力充沛的年轻女子。

examples.en: I tried aerobics, but it was too energetic for me.
examples.zh: 我试过有氧操，但对我来说太剧烈了。

examples.en: The dancers gave an energetic show, and everyone loved it.
examples.zh: 舞者们带来了一场充满活力的表演，大家都喜欢。

examples.en: He is 90, but he is still active in the town.
examples.zh: 他90岁了，但在镇上仍然很活跃。

examples.en: Our group wants people to stay active and healthy.
examples.zh: 我们团队希望人们保持活跃和健康。

examples.en: Try to keep active when you get older.
examples.zh: 年纪大了，要尽量保持活跃。

examples.en: Our school encouraged us to learn foreign languages.
examples.zh: 我们学校鼓励我们学习外语。

examples.en: The government is encouraging more job and fun places.
examples.zh: 政府正在鼓励建设更多工作和娱乐场所。

examples.en: They always encouraged me in everything I wanted to do.
examples.zh: 他们总是鼓励我做我想做的每件事。

examples.en: No one believed us about the Mars visitor.
examples.zh: 没人相信我们关于火星来客的事。

examples.en: He believes all kids are born smart.
examples.zh: 他相信所有孩子生来就聪明。

examples.en: I believe she will come tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我相信她明天会来。

examples.en: Her face is long and thin.
examples.zh: 她的脸又长又瘦。

examples.en: I saw some familiar faces in the crowd.
examples.zh: 我在人群里看见了几张熟悉的面孔。

examples.en: She had a confused look on her face.
examples.zh: 她脸上露出了困惑的表情。

examples.en: Why did you tell Bob about my illness? You can't keep a secret.
examples.zh: 你为什么把我的病告诉鲍勃？你保不住秘密。

examples.en: A close couple should share no secrets.
examples.zh: 亲密的夫妻之间不该有秘密。

examples.en: Won't you tell me the secret?
examples.zh: 你不告诉我这个秘密吗？

examples.en: A good friend always keeps secrets for you.
examples.zh: 好朋友总是为你保密。

examples.en: She promised to keep secrets about the surprise party.
examples.zh: 她答应保守惊喜派对的秘密。

examples.en: You should keep secrets when your classmates trust you.
examples.zh: 当同学信任你时，你应该保密。

examples.en: The living conditions are worse than we thought.
examples.zh: 居住条件比我们想的更差。

examples.en: If the rain gets worse, we must go back.
examples.zh: 如果雨下得更糟，我们必须回去。

examples.en: His manners are even worse than his sister's.
examples.zh: 他的举止比他姐姐的还要差。

examples.en: That was the worst dinner I had.
examples.zh: 那是我吃过的最差的一顿饭。

examples.en: She said it was the worst time in her life.
examples.zh: 她说那是她一生中最糟糕的时候。

examples.en: He is my worst enemy in class.
examples.zh: 他是我在班上最大的敌人。

examples.en: The height of New York's tall buildings is amazing.
examples.zh: 纽约高楼的高度令人惊叹。

examples.en: She is of average height, not tall or short.
examples.zh: 她中等身高，不高也不矮。

examples.en: The exact height of Mount Everest is still debated.
examples.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰的准确高度仍有争议。

examples.en: Wait a sec, I need to find my keys.
examples.zh: 等一下，我需要找我的钥匙。

examples.en: The light turned green just a few secs ago.
examples.zh: 几秒钟前绿灯刚亮。

examples.en: He ran 100 meters in 12 secs.
examples.zh: 他跑100米用了12秒。

examples.en: Our class is having a spelling test today.
examples.zh: 我们班今天有拼写测试。

examples.en: She took an aptitude test before getting the job.
examples.zh: 她在得到这份工作前参加了一个能力测试。

examples.en: The doctor asked me to take a blood test.
examples.zh: 医生让我做一次血液测试。

examples.en: We often play badminton in the park after school.
examples.zh: 放学后我们经常在公园打羽毛球。

examples.en: She bought a new badminton racket last weekend.
examples.zh: 她上周末买了一个新羽毛球拍。

examples.en: Badminton is easy to learn and fun to play.
examples.zh: 羽毛球容易学，打起来也很有趣。

examples.en: However hungry I am, I can't finish a whole pizza.
examples.zh: 无论我有多饿，我都吃不完一整块比萨。

examples.en: Emma buys what she likes, however much it costs.
examples.zh: 艾玛喜欢什么就买什么，不管它有多贵。

examples.en: I'll give you £20 for the tickets, or however much they cost.
examples.zh: 我会给你20英镑买票，或者不管它们花多少钱。

examples.en: We put balloons on the ceiling for the party.
examples.zh: 我们把气球挂在天花板上为聚会做准备。

examples.en: Doctors use a small balloon to open a blocked blood tube.
examples.zh: 医生用一个小气球来打开堵塞的血管。

examples.en: In 1783, people flew in a balloon for the first time.
examples.zh: 1783年，人们第一次乘气球飞行。

examples.en: He is scared of spiders.
examples.zh: 他怕蜘蛛。

examples.en: I'm scared to tell her the truth.
examples.zh: 我不敢告诉她真相。

examples.en: He is too scared to tell her the truth.
examples.zh: 他太害怕了，不敢告诉她真相。

examples.en: Some kids were fighting in the playground.
examples.zh: 一些孩子正在操场上打架。

examples.en: The soldiers fought in every house.
examples.zh: 士兵们在每栋房子里战斗。

examples.en: He was seen fighting with a man outside a club.
examples.zh: 有人看到他在俱乐部外面和一个男人打架。

examples.en: She has been dead for twenty years.
examples.zh: 她已经去世二十年了。

examples.en: The motorcyclist was dead when he reached the hospital.
examples.zh: 那个骑摩托车的人到医院时已经死了。

examples.en: The man was shot dead near his house.
examples.zh: 那个男人在家附近被枪击身亡。

examples.en: A group of young men attacked him and hurt him badly.
examples.zh: 一群年轻人袭击了他，把他伤得很重。

examples.en: The army has attacked the town since morning.
examples.zh: 军队从早上起就一直在攻击这座城镇。

examples.en: Most wild animals won't attack if you don't make them angry.
examples.zh: 大多数野生动物不会攻击你，除非你惹怒它们。

examples.en: I said I'd be home at six, but it's already gone seven.
examples.zh: 我说了六点回家，但现在已经七点多了。

examples.en: All my money is gone, so I can't buy any food.
examples.zh: 我的钱全没了，所以买不了任何食物。

examples.en: Luckily, I'll be dead and gone before the money is used up.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，在钱用完之前我已经死了并离开了。

examples.en: Danger! Don't come in!
examples.zh: 危险！不要进来！

examples.en: He drove too fast, so I felt my life was in danger.
examples.zh: 他开车太快了，所以我觉得生命有危险。

examples.en: The doctor says he is out of danger now.
examples.zh: 医生说他现在脱离危险了。

examples.en: He is a brave soldier in the army.
examples.zh: 他是军队里的一名勇敢的士兵。

examples.en: It was brave to quit her job and start a business.
examples.zh: 辞掉工作去创业是很勇敢的。

examples.en: She was brave to learn to ski at 50.
examples.zh: 她50岁学滑雪，真勇敢。

examples.en: I get along with my classmates very well.
examples.zh: 我和同学们相处得很好。

examples.en: Do you get along with your new neighbor?
examples.zh: 你和你的新邻居相处得好吗？

examples.en: She gets along with her brother easily.
examples.zh: 她和弟弟很容易和睦相处。

examples.en: Today on the show, we will answer questions from listeners.
examples.zh: 今天在节目中，我们将回答听众的问题。

examples.en: Millions of listeners enjoy listening to his podcasts.
examples.zh: 数百万听众喜欢听他的播客。

examples.en: We got many complaints from regular listeners about the changes.
examples.zh: 我们从常听节目的听众那里收到了许多关于节目变化的抱怨。

examples.en: Many people in the audience nodded in agreement.
examples.zh: 观众中许多人点头表示同意。

examples.en: She tasted the sauce and nodded in approval.
examples.zh: 她尝了尝酱汁，点头表示赞许。

examples.en: When I suggested a walk, Elena nodded happily.
examples.zh: 当我提议去散步时，埃琳娜高兴地点了点头。

examples.en: I had a tingling feeling in my fingers.
examples.zh: 我的手指有一种刺痛的感觉。

examples.en: I have a strange feeling in my stomach.
examples.zh: 我的胃里有一种奇怪的感觉。

examples.en: My toes were so cold that I lost all feeling in them.
examples.zh: 我的脚趾太冷了，以至于完全失去了知觉。

examples.en: I tried sailing once, but I didn't enjoy it.
examples.zh: 我试过一次帆船运动，但我不喜欢它。

examples.en: We eat lunch together once a month.
examples.zh: 我们每月一起吃一次午饭。

examples.en: They all began to talk at once.
examples.zh: 他们所有人都立刻开始说话了。

examples.en: Dr. Stephens is my doctor. I'm a patient of hers.
examples.zh: 斯蒂芬斯医生是我的医生。我是她的病人。

examples.en: Most patients can leave the hospital after three days.
examples.zh: 大多数病人在三天后就能出院。

examples.en: The nurse is patient and kind when she treats a patient.
examples.zh: 这位护士在治疗病人时既耐心又和善。

examples.en: He thinks carefully about his work. He is very thoughtful.
examples.zh: 他认真思考他的工作。他非常深思熟虑。

examples.en: You look thoughtful. What are you thinking about?
examples.zh: 你看起来在深思。你在想什么呢？

examples.en: Thank you for calling when I was ill. It was very thoughtful of you.
examples.zh: 谢谢你在我生病时打电话来。你真体贴。

examples.en: He covered the broken window with a plastic sheet.
examples.zh: 他用一块塑料布盖住了破窗户。

examples.en: Those flowers are not real; they are plastic ones.
examples.zh: 那些花不是真的，它们是塑料的。

examples.en: This company now makes plastic things.
examples.zh: 这家公司现在生产塑料制品。

examples.en: I bought a cheap plane ticket at the last minute.
examples.zh: 我最后一刻买了一张便宜的机票。

examples.en: Food in supermarkets is usually cheaper than in small shops.
examples.zh: 超市里的食物通常比小商店里的便宜。

examples.en: Kids and old people can get cheap train tickets.
examples.zh: 孩子和老人可以买到便宜的火车票。

examples.en: Some chemicals are banned because they harm the environment.
examples.zh: 一些化学物质因为伤害环境而被禁止。

examples.en: We should do more to keep the environment clean.
examples.zh: 我们应该做更多来保持环境干净。

examples.en: The radiation leak badly hurt the environment.
examples.zh: 辐射泄漏严重破坏了环境。

examples.en: I need to buy a few things in town.
examples.zh: 我需要在镇上买几样东西。

examples.en: I know quite a few people with the same problem.
examples.zh: 我认识不少有同样问题的人。

examples.en: Many club members are under 20, but a few are older.
examples.zh: 俱乐部里很多成员不到20岁，但也有几个年龄大些的。

examples.en: She acts in a new 12-part drama about a woman leaving prison.
examples.zh: 她在一部新的12集戏剧中出演，讲的是一位刚出狱的女性。

examples.en: Who are your favorite TV pairs in comedy and drama?
examples.zh: 在喜剧和戏剧中，你最喜欢的电视搭档是谁？

examples.en: The book became a BBC drama series.
examples.zh: 这本书被改编成了BBC的戏剧系列。

examples.en: Spain was the first foreign country she visited.
examples.zh: 西班牙是她参观过的第一个外国。

examples.en: Can you speak any foreign languages?
examples.zh: 你会说任何外语吗？

examples.en: His job gave him many chances for foreign travel.
examples.zh: 他的工作给了他很多出国旅行的机会。

examples.en: She will be as tall as her mom soon.
examples.zh: 她很快会和她妈妈一样高。

examples.en: I can't run as fast as you.
examples.zh: 我不能和你跑得一样快。

examples.en: Her skin is as soft as a baby's.
examples.zh: 她的皮肤像婴儿的一样柔软。

examples.en: This box is as heavy as that one.
examples.zh: 这个盒子和那个一样重。

examples.en: She sings as well as her sister.
examples.zh: 她唱得和她姐姐一样好。

examples.en: He runs as fast as a horse.
examples.zh: 他跑得和马一样快。

examples.en: First, french the lamb bones to make them clean.
examples.zh: 首先，把羊排骨头上的肉剔干净。

examples.en: After frenching the ribs, cover them with foil to keep them from burning.
examples.zh: 剔好肋骨后，用锡纸包住它们，防止烤焦。

examples.en: In Paris, many young couples were frenching in the park.
examples.zh: 在巴黎，许多年轻情侣在公园里接吻。

examples.en: A group of Germans live in our hotel now.
examples.zh: 一群德国人现在住在我们的旅馆里。

examples.en: The German visitors like the food here.
examples.zh: 这些德国游客喜欢这里的食物。

examples.en: My friend speaks German very well.
examples.zh: 我朋友德语说得很好。

examples.en: She leaned forward and said something in my ear.
examples.zh: 她向前倾身，在我耳边说了些什么。

examples.en: The player kicked the ball forward to surprise the other team.
examples.zh: 那个球员向前踢球，想让对方队伍措手不及。

examples.en: The army moved forward toward the enemy camp.
examples.zh: 军队向前行进，朝敌方营地而去。

examples.en: I look forward to your birthday party next week.
examples.zh: 我期待下周你的生日派对。

examples.en: She is looking forward to seeing her grandparents this summer.
examples.zh: 她期待今年夏天见到她的祖父母。

examples.en: We look forward to hearing your good news.
examples.zh: 我们期待听到你的好消息。

examples.en: We went into the house to keep warm.
examples.zh: 我们走进房子里取暖。

examples.en: I went to Paris last summer. You know?
examples.zh: 我去年夏天去了巴黎。你知道吗？

examples.en: We don't go to the movies much now.
examples.zh: 我们现在不常去看电影。

examples.en: Don't be afraid; just have a go at the new game.
examples.zh: 别害怕，就试一下这个新游戏吧。

examples.en: She had a go at painting, and she loved it.
examples.zh: 她试着画画，结果非常喜欢。

examples.en: Let's have a go at making a model plane together.
examples.zh: 让我们一起试着做一架模型飞机吧。

examples.en: A big earthquake hit San Francisco in 1906.
examples.zh: 1906年一场大地震袭击了旧金山。

examples.en: We often use words like strong and big with earthquake.
examples.zh: 我们经常用strong和big这样的词搭配earthquake。

examples.en: After a destructive earthquake, people must be very careful.
examples.zh: 破坏性地震过后，人们必须非常小心。

examples.en: I feel bad that I didn't offer them any food.
examples.zh: 我很后悔没有给他们提供食物。

examples.en: She got an offer for a job in Paris.
examples.zh: 她得到了一个在巴黎的工作机会。

examples.en: Can I offer you a drink?
examples.zh: 我可以给你提供一杯饮料吗？

examples.en: It's a late-night arts programme on TV.
examples.zh: 这是一个深夜播出的艺术类电视节目。

examples.en: This is my favourite TV programme, so I never miss it.
examples.zh: 这是我最喜欢的电视节目，所以我从不缺席。

examples.en: I heard a very interesting radio programme this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我听了一个非常有趣的广播节目。

examples.en: Would you like more juice? No thanks, I've had plenty.
examples.zh: 再来点果汁吗？不用了，谢谢，我已经喝了很多。

examples.en: Don't grab the balloons, kids. There are plenty for all of you.
examples.zh: 孩子们别抢气球，足够你们每个人的。

examples.en: We have plenty of time before we go to the airport.
examples.zh: 去机场前我们还有很多时间。

examples.en: There are plenty of books on the shelf.
examples.zh: 书架上有大量的书。

examples.en: We have plenty of time to finish the work.
examples.zh: 我们有大量的时间完成这项工作。

examples.en: She drinks plenty of water every day.
examples.zh: 她每天喝大量的水。

examples.en: She is a hands-on manager and likes to work with her team.
examples.zh: 她是一位实际操作的经理，喜欢和团队一起工作。

examples.en: Hands-on experience is as useful as good grades for jobs.
examples.zh: 实际经验对于找工作来说，和好成绩一样有用。

examples.en: Our teacher is hands-on and often helps us do science experiments.
examples.zh: 我们的老师很注重实际操作，经常帮我们做科学实验。

examples.en: Please wait, and I will give you my full attention.
examples.zh: 请等一下，我会把全部注意力都放在你身上。

examples.en: Kids usually have a short attention span, so they can't focus for long.
examples.zh: 孩子们通常注意力持续时间短，所以他们不能长时间集中精神。

examples.en: They plan a campaign to draw attention to car pollution.
examples.zh: 他们计划开展一个活动来引起人们对汽车污染的注意。

examples.en: Please pay attention to the teacher in class.
examples.zh: 上课时请注意听老师讲。

examples.en: You should pay attention to the traffic lights.
examples.zh: 你应该注意红绿灯。

examples.en: She paid attention to the spelling of each word.
examples.zh: 她注意了每个单词的拼写。

examples.en: I wasn't aware that he was sick.
examples.zh: 我没意识到他生病了。

examples.en: Were you aware of the danger then?
examples.zh: 你当时意识到危险了吗？

examples.en: She was very aware that he had a wife.
examples.zh: 她很清楚他已经有妻子了。

examples.en: Please be aware of the traffic lights when crossing the road.
examples.zh: 过马路时请留意红绿灯。

examples.en: She was not aware of her mistake until the teacher told her.
examples.zh: 直到老师告诉她，她才意识到自己的错误。

examples.en: Be aware of the wet floor, or you may slip and fall.
examples.zh: 小心湿滑的地面，否则你可能会滑倒。

examples.en: The health report shows the importance of fresh food.
examples.zh: 健康报告显示了新鲜食物的重要性。

examples.en: She gives great importance to her personal things.
examples.zh: 她非常重视她的个人物品。

examples.en: Remember the importance of being neat and polite at work.
examples.zh: 记住在工作中整洁和礼貌的重要性。

examples.en: The Japanese stock market is very big.
examples.zh: 日本股票市场非常大。

examples.en: I like Japanese art very much.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢日本艺术。

examples.en: Can you speak Japanese?
examples.zh: 你会说日语吗？

examples.en: We bought ourselves some food for lunch.
examples.zh: 我们给自己买了些午饭吃。

examples.en: John and I promised ourselves a nice trip this year.
examples.zh: 约翰和我答应自己今年去好好旅行一次。

examples.en: We ourselves see the problems in this plan.
examples.zh: 我们自己看到了这个计划中的问题。

examples.en: It was clear that he wasn't developing like other boys.
examples.zh: 很明显，他和其他男孩不一样，发育得不同。

examples.en: Small fights may develop into big problems.
examples.zh: 小争吵可能会发展成大问题。

examples.en: Their meeting slowly developed into a good friendship.
examples.zh: 他们的相遇慢慢发展成了深厚的友谊。

examples.en: Tom is an office junior and helps with simple tasks.
examples.zh: 汤姆是一名办公室初级职员，帮忙做简单的工作。

examples.en: Lewis has just moved up to the junior team this year.
examples.zh: 刘易斯今年刚升入初级队。

examples.en: The Saturday morning classes are only for juniors.
examples.zh: 周六早上的课只对初级学员开放。

examples.en: They sent a rocket to Venus.
examples.zh: 他们向金星发射了一枚火箭。

examples.en: The soldiers shot rockets at the tanks.
examples.zh: 士兵们向坦克发射了火箭弹。

examples.en: The rocket launch countdown starts at 9 a.m.
examples.zh: 火箭发射的倒计时从上午9点开始。

examples.en: What are you doing at lunchtime?
examples.zh: 午餐时间你在做什么？

examples.en: I saw my teacher at lunchtime yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天午餐时间我看到了我的老师。

examples.en: Let's meet at lunchtime and eat together.
examples.zh: 我们午餐时间见面，一起吃吧。

examples.en: Of the four groups, this one has the least chance to win.
examples.zh: 在这四个小组中，这一组获胜的机会最少。

examples.en: The accident came when we least thought about it.
examples.zh: 事故在我们最没想到的时候发生了。

examples.en: That was the answer she least wanted to hear.
examples.zh: 那是最不想听到的回答。

examples.en: We study international politics in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上学习国际政治。

examples.en: An international team of scientists works together.
examples.zh: 一个国际科学家团队一起工作。

examples.en: She runs a big international company.
examples.zh: 她经营一家大型国际公司。

examples.en: My wife and I were on vacation in California.
examples.zh: 我和妻子在加利福尼亚度假。

examples.en: We were all tired and wanted to go on vacation.
examples.zh: 我们都很累，想去度假。

examples.en: He is in this photo on a vacation in Acapulco.
examples.zh: 他在这张照片里，在阿卡普尔科度假。

examples.en: I left my science textbook at home today.
examples.zh: 我今天把科学课本落在家里了。

examples.en: Taylor's goal was a textbook one, so clean.
examples.zh: 泰勒的进球很标准，非常漂亮。

examples.en: This is a textbook example of solving problems well.
examples.zh: 这是妥善解决问题的典型范例。

examples.en: The police searched the woods for the lost boy.
examples.zh: 警察在树林里搜寻那个走失的男孩。

examples.en: She searched his face for any sign of forgiveness, but saw none.
examples.zh: 她在他脸上寻找原谅的迹象，但什么也没看到。

examples.en: She searched in the drawer for her passport.
examples.zh: 她在抽屉里翻找她的护照。

examples.en: I will call you when I finish my homework.
examples.zh: 我做完作业后给你打电话。

examples.en: Please put your paper in the box when you finish.
examples.zh: 你完成后请把问卷放进盒子里。

examples.en: She finished the show with a song from her first CD.
examples.zh: 她用第一张专辑里的一首歌结束了演出。

examples.en: She likes American movies very much.
examples.zh: 她非常喜欢美国电影。

examples.en: My American friend teaches me English.
examples.zh: 我的美国朋友教我英语。

examples.en: We visited an American museum last week.
examples.zh: 我们上周参观了一个美国博物馆。

examples.en: You can find a hamburger restaurant anywhere in the world.
examples.zh: 你可以在世界各地找到汉堡包餐厅。

examples.en: We ate hamburgers for lunch and then watched a movie.
examples.zh: 我们午餐吃了汉堡包，然后看了一场电影。

examples.en: A hamburger is a quick snack, but it has many calories.
examples.zh: 汉堡包是快餐，但含有许多卡路里。

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for its deep-pan pizza.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅以它的厚底比萨饼而闻名。

examples.en: I like many different pizza toppings, like cheese and ham.
examples.zh: 我喜欢很多不同的比萨配料，比如奶酪和火腿。

examples.en: You can make a pizza base with flour and water.
examples.zh: 你可以用面粉和水做比萨饼底。

examples.en: I like a fried egg for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐喜欢吃煎蛋。

examples.en: My mom often cooks fried onions with beef.
examples.zh: 我妈妈经常用洋葱炒牛肉。

examples.en: The fried chicken smells so good.
examples.zh: 炸鸡闻起来真香。

examples.en: Mix the salad with some dressing.
examples.zh: 把沙拉和调料拌一拌。

examples.en: I made a mixed salad for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐做了一份混合沙拉。

examples.en: Serve the rice with a green salad.
examples.zh: 把米饭和绿色沙拉一起端上桌。

examples.en: He used ivory chopsticks to eat rice from a bowl every evening.
examples.zh: 他每天晚上用象牙筷子从碗里吃米饭。

examples.en: On the table, there are four bowls, two small dishes, and a bag with chopsticks.
examples.zh: 桌子上有四个碗、两个小碟子，还有一个装着筷子的袋子。

examples.en: We ate with forks and chopsticks, and each guest had soy or vinegar beside him.
examples.zh: 我们用叉子和筷子吃饭，每位客人旁边都有酱油或醋。

examples.en: My favorite movie is about love and war.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的电影是关于爱情和战争的。

examples.en: What movies are showing this week?
examples.zh: 这周有什么电影上映？

examples.en: Do you want to watch a movie with me tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚想和我一起看部电影吗？

examples.en: What's the difference between an ape and a monkey?
examples.zh: 猿和猴子之间有什么区别？

examples.en: Is there a big difference in quality between these two things?
examples.zh: 这两样东西在质量上有很大差别吗？

examples.en: What's the difference between the two cars?
examples.zh: 这两辆车有什么区别？

examples.en: I like chocolate-chip cookies best.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢巧克力曲奇饼干。

examples.en: You bought my favorite cookies. How smart!
examples.zh: 你买了我最喜欢的饼干。真聪明！

examples.en: Eat three meals a day, so you don't need cookies.
examples.zh: 一天吃三顿饭，就不用吃饼干了。

examples.en: She put a knife and fork on the table for dinner.
examples.zh: 她在餐桌上放了刀叉准备吃晚饭。

examples.en: She used her fork to check if the cake was ready.
examples.zh: 她用叉子检查蛋糕是否熟了。

examples.en: Use a fork to make small holes in the potatoes before baking.
examples.zh: 烤土豆前，用叉子在土豆上扎些小孔。

examples.en: I eat soup with a soup spoon.
examples.zh: 我用汤勺喝汤。

examples.en: She uses a serving spoon to put food on plates.
examples.zh: 她用分餐勺把食物放到盘子里。

examples.en: My grandpa has an old wooden spoon.
examples.zh: 我爷爷有一把旧木勺。

examples.en: She thinks opera is boring.
examples.zh: 她觉得歌剧很没趣。

examples.en: Sitting on the plane with no books is boring.
examples.zh: 在飞机上坐着没书看很无聊。

examples.en: The lecture was so boring that I slept.
examples.zh: 那个讲座太无聊了，我都睡着了。

examples.en: I don't know what to wear tonight. Do you have any suggestions?
examples.zh: 我今晚不知道穿什么。你有什么建议吗？

examples.en: She gave some helpful suggestions, but her boss said no to all.
examples.zh: 她提了一些有用的建议，但老板全都拒绝了。

examples.en: They didn't like my suggestion that we share the cost together.
examples.zh: 他们不喜欢我提出的大家分摊费用的建议。

examples.en: You must wear your school uniform every day.
examples.zh: 你每天都必须穿校服。

examples.en: The nurse looks nice in her white uniform.
examples.zh: 那个护士穿着白色制服很好看。

examples.en: I like the man in uniform over there.
examples.zh: 我喜欢那边穿制服的那个男人。

examples.en: He worked hard to improve factory workers' lives.
examples.zh: 他努力工作以改善工厂工人的生活。

examples.en: I thought living in France could improve my French.
examples.zh: 我觉得住在法国能提高我的法语。

examples.en: Her health improved a lot after the new diet.
examples.zh: 开始新饮食后，她的健康改善了很多。

examples.en: I suggested the Italian restaurant near the station for our party.
examples.zh: 我建议聚会去车站附近那家意大利餐馆。

examples.en: May I suggest a white wine with your fish, sir?
examples.zh: 先生，我可以建议您用白葡萄酒配鱼吗？

examples.en: I suggest that we wait a little before we decide.
examples.zh: 我建议我们等一下再做决定。

examples.en: This book provides useful info about local services.
examples.zh: 这本书提供关于本地服务的有用信息。

examples.en: The hotel provides free breakfast for all guests.
examples.zh: 这家酒店为所有客人提供免费早餐。

examples.en: The school provides us with many books to read.
examples.zh: 学校为我们提供许多书来读。

examples.en: The report is bad. Moreover, it has many mistakes.
examples.zh: 这份报告很差。此外，它还有很多错误。

examples.en: Moreover, he has a problem in his party.
examples.zh: 此外，他在党内遇到了一个问题。

examples.en: He likes selling. Moreover, he is good at it.
examples.zh: 他喜欢销售。此外，他还很擅长。

examples.en: Please write 'yours sincerely' at the end of your letter.
examples.zh: 请在信的末尾写上‘谨上’。

examples.en: She signed the email with 'yours sincerely' to her teacher.
examples.zh: 她在给老师的邮件结尾签了‘谨上’。

examples.en: In a formal letter, remember to use 'yours sincerely' before your name.
examples.zh: 在正式信中，记得在名字前用‘谨上’。

examples.en: He learns new things fast and is a quick learner.
examples.zh: 他学新东西很快，是个快速学习者。

examples.en: A learner driver must be careful on the road.
examples.zh: 学习驾驶的人在路上必须小心。

examples.en: Good learners often ask questions in class.
examples.zh: 好的学习者经常在课堂上提问。

examples.en: I often feed my neighbor's cat when she is not at home.
examples.zh: 邻居不在家时，我经常喂她的猫。

examples.en: Let's feed the children first, then we can eat dinner.
examples.zh: 我们先喂孩子们吃，然后再吃晚饭。

examples.en: Do you feed your chickens corn every day?
examples.zh: 你每天都喂你的鸡吃玉米吗？

examples.en: We can fish in the freshwater river.
examples.zh: 我们可以在淡水河里钓鱼。

examples.en: Several big fish swim in the small pond.
examples.zh: 几条大鱼在小池塘里游。

examples.en: People catch sea fish with big nets.
examples.zh: 人们用大网捕海鱼。

examples.en: We will see many tech changes in our lifetime.
examples.zh: 我们一生中会看到许多科技变化。

examples.en: I never thought this could happen during my lifetime.
examples.zh: 我从没想过这事会在我有生之年发生。

examples.en: The prize winner will enjoy the trip of a lifetime.
examples.zh: 获奖者将享受一生中最棒的旅行。

examples.en: I love going on long journeys with my family.
examples.zh: 我喜欢和家人一起进行长途旅行。

examples.en: We broke our journey in a small town and rested there.
examples.zh: 我们中途在一个小镇停留并休息了一下。

examples.en: Have a safe journey and write to me soon.
examples.zh: 祝你一路平安，并尽快给我写信。

examples.en: He won the fight with a single punch.
examples.zh: 他用一拳就赢了这场打斗。

examples.en: Not a single person came to help her.
examples.zh: 没有一个人来帮助她。

examples.en: You didn't hear a single word I said.
examples.zh: 我说的话你一个字都没听见。

examples.en: Why not put the bed against the wall?
examples.zh: 为什么不把床靠墙放呢？

examples.en: He liked her soft hair against his face.
examples.zh: 他喜欢她柔软的头发贴着他的脸。

examples.en: The rain hit against her face in the wind.
examples.zh: 雨中，雨水打在她的脸上。

examples.en: If you don't do your homework, you will fall behind in class.
examples.zh: 如果你不做作业，你会在课堂上落后的。

examples.en: He fell behind the others because he walked too slowly.
examples.zh: 他因为走得太慢，落在了其他人后面。

examples.en: Don't fall behind in your studies during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期里不要在学习上落后。

examples.en: The doctors did a successful operation on him.
examples.zh: 医生对他进行了一次成功的手术。

examples.en: My second try at making bread was more successful.
examples.zh: 我第二次做面包更成功了一些。

examples.en: This year's harvest was one of the most successful ever.
examples.zh: 今年的收成是有史以来最成功的之一。

examples.en: Hunger is a strong drive for us to eat.
examples.zh: 饥饿是我们进食的一种强烈本能需求。

examples.en: His drive to win makes him practice hard.
examples.zh: 他对胜利的渴望驱使他努力练习。

examples.en: The mother's drive to protect her baby is natural.
examples.zh: 母亲保护宝宝的本能需求是天生的。

examples.en: He bought a bird guide before his trip to Canada.
examples.zh: 他在去加拿大旅行前买了一本鸟类指南。

examples.en: We suggest you buy a good guide to Spain first.
examples.zh: 我们建议你先买一本好的西班牙旅行指南。

examples.en: This hotel guide helps you find a nice place to stay.
examples.zh: 这本酒店指南帮你找到好的住宿地方。

examples.en: She was a lifelong member of the party.
examples.zh: 她是这个政党的终身成员。

examples.en: Reading every day is a lifelong habit.
examples.zh: 每天阅读是一个终生的习惯。

examples.en: He has had a lifelong interest in science.
examples.zh: 他对科学有着终生的兴趣。

examples.en: So inventors had to be more creative over time.
examples.zh: 所以发明家们随着时间的推移必须变得更有创造力。

examples.en: Inventors used science to make new weapons.
examples.zh: 发明家们用科学制造新武器。

examples.en: Some people have new science ideas and become inventors.
examples.zh: 有些人有新的科学想法，成为发明家。

examples.en: She had a talent for singing when she was five.
examples.zh: 她五岁时就展现出了唱歌的天赋。

examples.en: His art talent was not used in his boring work.
examples.zh: 他的艺术才能在他无聊的工作中没被用到。

examples.en: She has great running talent, but she needs hard training.
examples.zh: 她有很好的跑步天赋，但她需要刻苦训练。

examples.en: The city center has changed little in a century.
examples.zh: 一个世纪以来，市中心变化很小。

examples.en: This old sculpture is probably centuries old.
examples.zh: 这座古老的雕塑可能有几百年历史了。

examples.en: She worked as a doctor for half a century.
examples.zh: 她当医生工作了半个世纪。

examples.en: The title is in bold print.
examples.zh: 标题是粗体印刷的。

examples.en: This book uses large print for poor eyesight.
examples.zh: 这本书用大号字体印刷，方便视力不好的人。

examples.en: The book was printed and sold quickly.
examples.zh: 这本书很快被印刷并出售了。

examples.en: He cut himself while shaving.
examples.zh: 他刮胡子时割伤了自己。

examples.en: He often cried himself to sleep at night.
examples.zh: 他夜里常常哭着睡着。

examples.en: Do you want to talk to the chairman himself or his assistant?
examples.zh: 你想和主席本人谈，还是和他的助手谈？

examples.en: An online bookseller sells books on the Internet.
examples.zh: 一个网上书商在互联网上卖书。

examples.en: The online bookseller gives a rating for each book.
examples.zh: 这个网上书商给每本书一个评分。

examples.en: You can buy this book from big booksellers.
examples.zh: 你可以从大书商那里买到这本书。

examples.en: She studies hard in order to pass the exam.
examples.zh: 她努力学习为了通过考试。

examples.en: He gets up early in order to catch the first bus.
examples.zh: 他早起为了赶上第一班公交车。

examples.en: We practice English every day in order to speak better.
examples.zh: 我们每天练习英语为了说得更好。

examples.en: Odysseus returned home after years of travel.
examples.zh: 奥德修斯在旅行多年后回到了家。

examples.en: They finish training this week and will return home.
examples.zh: 他们这周完成训练，然后会回家。

examples.en: She left South Africa at 15 and never returned.
examples.zh: 她15岁离开南非，再也没有回去过。

examples.en: I was curious about the next thing.
examples.zh: 我对接下来会发生的事情很好奇。

examples.en: Babies are curious about everything around them.
examples.zh: 婴儿对周围的一切都感到好奇。

examples.en: “Why did you ask?” “I was just curious.”
examples.zh: “你为什么问？” “我只是好奇。”

examples.en: The recent storm blew down many trees.
examples.zh: 最近的暴风雨刮倒了许多树。

examples.en: The storm was very severe last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚的暴风雨非常猛烈。

examples.en: A big storm is coming, so stay inside.
examples.zh: 一场大暴风雨要来了，所以待在家里。

examples.en: The report's finding shows less violent crime, and it supports the police chief.
examples.zh: 报告的调查发现显示暴力犯罪减少了，这支持了警察局长的说法。

examples.en: These new findings change the old theories completely.
examples.zh: 这些新的调查发现彻底改变了旧理论。

examples.en: The survey's findings surprise me—they are not what I expected.
examples.zh: 这项调查的调查发现让我惊讶——它们不是我所预料的。

examples.en: We still can't predict earthquakes accurately.
examples.zh: 我们仍然无法准确预测地震。

examples.en: Who could have predicted he'd run the whole company in ten years?
examples.zh: 谁能预测到他十年内会管理整个公司呢？

examples.en: The hurricane is predicted to hit the coast tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 据预测，飓风将于明天早上到达海岸。

examples.en: There are countless reasons to say no to this silly plan.
examples.zh: 有数不清的理由拒绝这个愚蠢的计划。

examples.en: I've heard that song countless times on the radio.
examples.zh: 我在收音机里听过这首歌无数次。

examples.en: Countless times when I needed a friend, she would listen to me.
examples.zh: 无数回当我需要朋友时，她都会听我说话。

examples.en: The world changed fast after the invention of the phone.
examples.zh: 电话发明后，世界变化很快。

examples.en: It is a most amazing invention.
examples.zh: 这是一个最令人惊叹的发明。

examples.en: The invention of the pill changed women's lives greatly.
examples.zh: 避孕药的发明极大地改变了女性的生活。

examples.en: It comes as no surprise that he won the game.
examples.zh: 他赢了比赛不足为奇。

examples.en: Her success came as no surprise to us.
examples.zh: 她的成功对我们来说不足为奇。

examples.en: The bad news came as no surprise to the class.
examples.zh: 这个坏消息对全班来说不足为奇。

examples.en: King C. Gillette invented the first safety razor in 1903.
examples.zh: 金·C·吉列在1903年发明了第一把安全剃须刀。

examples.en: Let me make you a cup of coffee. It's a great invention.
examples.zh: 我给你泡杯咖啡吧。这是个伟大的发明。

examples.en: California grows many grapes. Someone invented new wine tools.
examples.zh: 加利福尼亚种植很多葡萄。有人发明了新的酿酒工具。

examples.en: I got this book for free from the library.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆免费得到了这本书。

examples.en: The children can watch the movie for free today.
examples.zh: 孩子们今天可以免费看这部电影。

examples.en: She helped me with my homework for free.
examples.zh: 她免费帮我做了家庭作业。

examples.en: Her greatness as a writer is clear to everyone.
examples.zh: 她作为作家的伟大对每个人来说都很清楚。

examples.en: They proudly think their country's greatness in history is big.
examples.zh: 他们自豪地认为他们国家历史上的伟大很了不起。

examples.en: She is sure of Washington's greatness as president.
examples.zh: 她确信华盛顿作为总统的伟大。

examples.en: I never read further than page five of that book.
examples.zh: 那本书我从来没有读到超过第五页。

examples.en: We talked about the problem but didn't get further in solving it.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了问题，但在解决它方面没有取得更多进展。

examples.en: The problem is further made hard because Ann and Joe don't talk.
examples.zh: 因为安和乔不说话，这个问题变得更难解决了。

examples.en: The success of a project depends much on its manager.
examples.zh: 项目的成功很大程度上取决于它的经理。

examples.en: I tried to persuade her to hire more people, but without success.
examples.zh: 我试图说服她多雇人，但没有成功。

examples.en: I am having little success in talking with him now.
examples.zh: 我现在和他沟通没什么成功。

examples.en: Italian food is very popular in China.
examples.zh: 意大利食物在中国很受欢迎。

examples.en: We met three Italians at the party.
examples.zh: 我们在聚会上遇见了三个意大利人。

examples.en: I'm learning Italian now, but it's hard.
examples.zh: 我现在正在学意大利语，但很难。

examples.en: They asked themselves why they made mistakes.
examples.zh: 他们问自己为什么犯了错误。

examples.en: Did the kids enjoy themselves at the party?
examples.zh: 孩子们在派对上玩得开心吗？

examples.en: They themselves didn't know what was happening.
examples.zh: 他们自己不知道正在发生什么。

examples.en: She had a strange conversation with her new neighbor upstairs.
examples.zh: 她和楼上新搬来的邻居进行了一次奇怪的交谈。

examples.en: It's hard to carry on a conversation with so much noise.
examples.zh: 噪音这么大，很难进行交谈。

examples.en: I started a fun conversation with your uncle at the party.
examples.zh: 我在聚会上和你叔叔开始了一次有趣的交谈。

examples.en: We had to translate ten sentences for homework.
examples.zh: 我们得翻译十个句子作为作业。

examples.en: She translates English news into French for TV.
examples.zh: 她为电视台把英语新闻翻译成法语。

examples.en: Can you translate this idea into a simple plan?
examples.zh: 你能把这个想法翻译成一个简单的计划吗？

examples.en: Turn to page 134 for details on the competition.
examples.zh: 翻到第134页查看比赛详情。

examples.en: The story is on the front page of the newspaper.
examples.zh: 这个故事在报纸的头版上。

examples.en: Someone tore many pages out of this book.
examples.zh: 有人从这本书里撕掉了很多页。

examples.en: Her childhood events badly affected her.
examples.zh: 她童年时的事情严重影响了她。

examples.en: Luckily, no passenger was badly hurt in the crash.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，事故中没有乘客受重伤。

examples.en: I think he was treated very badly.
examples.zh: 我觉得他受到了很糟糕的对待。

examples.en: Be careful with the knife, or you'll hurt yourself!
examples.zh: 小心那把刀，不然你会伤到自己！

examples.en: Katie, please calm yourself down now!
examples.zh: 凯蒂，请你现在冷静下来！

examples.en: Did you make this dress yourself?
examples.zh: 这条裙子是你自己做的吗？

examples.en: Please help yourselves to some fruit, kids.
examples.zh: 孩子们，请随便吃些水果吧。

examples.en: You should be proud of yourselves for winning the game.
examples.zh: 你们应该为赢得比赛而为自己感到骄傲。

examples.en: Did you enjoy yourselves at the party last night?
examples.zh: 你们昨晚在聚会上玩得开心吗？

examples.en: Cliff Richard recorded more hit songs than any other British pop star.
examples.zh: 克里夫·理查德录制的热门歌曲比任何其他英国流行歌星都多。

examples.en: We recorded their wedding on video.
examples.zh: 我们用视频录下了他们的婚礼。

examples.en: I called her, but got a recorded message saying she was away.
examples.zh: 我给她打电话，但只听到一段录音留言，说她外出了。

examples.en: We use a laser printer to print our homework.
examples.zh: 我们用激光打印机打印作业。

examples.en: My dad works as a printer in a small factory.
examples.zh: 我爸爸在一家小工厂里当印刷工。

examples.en: The color printer can print photos quickly.
examples.zh: 这台彩色打印机可以快速打印照片。

examples.en: My aunt is a slashie, a teacher and a singer.
examples.zh: 我姑姑是斜杠族，既是老师又是歌手。

examples.en: Being a slashie gives people more money and fun.
examples.zh: 当斜杠族让人们有更多钱和乐趣。

examples.en: Tom became a slashie last year, working as a cook and a driver.
examples.zh: 汤姆去年成了斜杠族，既当厨师又当司机。

examples.en: People in different areas speak their own dialects.
examples.zh: 不同地区的人说自己的方言。

examples.en: The story was told in a local dialect.
examples.zh: 这个故事是用当地方言讲的。

examples.en: My grandma often uses her hometown dialect at home.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在家经常说家乡方言。

examples.en: Besides basketball, do you play other sports?
examples.zh: 除了篮球，你还玩其他运动吗？

examples.en: She won't be angry; besides, it's not your fault.
examples.zh: 她不会生气的；再说，这不是你的错。

examples.en: The fair has bands and shows, and much more besides.
examples.zh: 集市上有乐队和表演，还有很多别的。

examples.en: I can't finish it all by Friday. It's just not possible.
examples.zh: 我周五前做不完所有事，这根本不可能。

examples.en: Is it possible to buy tickets before we go?
examples.zh: 我们出发前有可能买到票吗？

examples.en: They went as far as possible before turning back.
examples.zh: 他们尽可能走得远，然后才返回。

examples.en: Please finish your homework as quickly as possible.
examples.zh: 请尽快完成你的作业。

examples.en: She always tries to speak English as clearly as possible.
examples.zh: 她总是尽可能清晰地说英语。

examples.en: We should plant more trees as early as possible in spring.
examples.zh: 我们应该在春天尽早种更多的树。

examples.en: He is impatient and often cuts me off in a sentence.
examples.zh: 他没耐心，经常在我说到一半时打断我。

examples.en: Your ending is fine, but the last sentence is too long and hard.
examples.zh: 你的结尾不错，但最后一个句子太长太难了。

examples.en: In the sentence 'Bob threw the ball', 'Bob' is the subject.
examples.zh: 在句子“Bob threw the ball”中，“Bob”是主语。

examples.en: I would rather read books than watch TV.
examples.zh: 我宁愿看书而不是看电视。

examples.en: She chose to walk rather than take a bus.
examples.zh: 她选择走路而不是坐公交车。

examples.en: We like to play outside rather than stay at home.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢在外面玩而不是待在家里。

examples.en: English pronunciation is really hard for us.
examples.zh: 英语发音对我们来说真的很难。

examples.en: This word has two different pronunciations.
examples.zh: 这个单词有两种不同的发音。

examples.en: The teacher's correction helped our pronunciation.
examples.zh: 老师的纠正帮助了我们的发音。

examples.en: I need a German grammar book.
examples.zh: 我需要一本德语语法书。

examples.en: These books cover grammar very well.
examples.zh: 这些书把语法覆盖得很好。

examples.en: Our school focuses on writing and grammar.
examples.zh: 我们学校注重写作和语法。

examples.en: This book has five hundred pages of text.
examples.zh: 这本书有五百页正文。

examples.en: I will text you when I get any news.
examples.zh: 我一有消息就发短信给你。

examples.en: Can you show us the full text of your speech before Tuesday?
examples.zh: 你能在周二前给我们看你演讲的全文吗？

examples.en: Could you speak more slowly, please?
examples.zh: 请你说话慢一点好吗？

examples.en: I got up and walked slowly to the door.
examples.zh: 我起床后慢慢走向门口。

examples.en: Please walk more slowly! I can't follow you.
examples.zh: 请走慢一点！我跟不上你。

examples.en: I cleaned for the whole day.
examples.zh: 我打扫了一整天。

examples.en: There is a whole month before my birthday.
examples.zh: 离我生日还有整整一个月。

examples.en: After exercise class, my whole body hurt.
examples.zh: 体育课后，我全身都疼。

examples.en: His speech at the meeting was very moving.
examples.zh: 他在会上的演讲非常感人。

examples.en: The little girl lost her speech after the accident.
examples.zh: 那次事故后，小女孩失去了说话的能力。

examples.en: We listened to the teacher's speech about kindness.
examples.zh: 我们听了老师关于善良的演讲。

examples.en: He read her letter aloud to his family.
examples.zh: 他大声把她的信读给家人听。

examples.en: People now wonder aloud if the reforms went too far.
examples.zh: 人们现在公开质疑改革是否走得太远了。

examples.en: It's good practice to say the speech aloud a few times.
examples.zh: 把演讲大声说几遍是个好练习。

examples.en: How do you pronounce your last name?
examples.zh: 你的姓怎么发音？

examples.en: She pronounced his name badly, so he didn't know it.
examples.zh: 她把他名字读得很差，所以他都没听出来。

examples.en: Sade, pronounced shah-day, sings very well.
examples.zh: 萨德，读作沙-戴，唱歌很好听。

examples.en: Did I say your name correctly?
examples.zh: 我把你的名字说对了吗？

examples.en: Answer this question correctly and you can win a car!
examples.zh: 正确回答这个问题，你就能赢一辆车！

examples.en: My mom took speech lessons to speak correctly.
examples.zh: 我妈妈上演讲课来学习正确说话。

examples.en: His spelling is really bad.
examples.zh: 他的拼写真的很差。

examples.en: My computer can fix my spelling mistakes.
examples.zh: 我的电脑能修正我的拼写错误。

examples.en: Your essay has many spelling errors.
examples.zh: 你的文章里有很多拼写错误。

examples.en: If a café is nearby, let's stop for a snack.
examples.zh: 如果附近有咖啡馆，我们停下来吃点东西吧。

examples.en: I saw a policeman standing nearby.
examples.zh: 我看见一个警察站在附近。

examples.en: We stopped at some nearby shops to buy food.
examples.zh: 我们在附近的商店停下来买了些食物。

examples.en: Would you mind repeating your question?
examples.zh: 你介意重复一下你的问题吗？

examples.en: Please don't repeat my words to others.
examples.zh: 请不要把我的话告诉别人。

examples.en: She repeated that she would not run for president.
examples.zh: 她重复说她不会竞选总统。

examples.en: Millions of tourists visit Rome every year.
examples.zh: 每年有数百万游客参观罗马。

examples.en: Thousands of tourists go to the Mediterranean every year.
examples.zh: 每年有成千上万的游客去地中海。

examples.en: Florida has many famous tourist attractions.
examples.zh: 佛罗里达有许多著名的旅游景点。

examples.en: My grandma makes mooncakes for us every Mid-Autumn Festival.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每年中秋节都给我们做月饼。

examples.en: This mooncake has a sweet red bean filling inside.
examples.zh: 这块月饼里面有甜甜的红豆馅。

examples.en: We shared a mooncake and watched the bright moon last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我们分享了一块月饼，还看了明亮的月亮。

examples.en: Please clean the glass shelf in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 请打扫厨房里的玻璃架子。

examples.en: Put the food on the top shelf of the fridge.
examples.zh: 把食物放在冰箱的最上层架子上。

examples.en: The tall shelf is full of books from floor to ceiling.
examples.zh: 那个高高的架子从地板到天花板都堆满了书。

examples.en: Rose bushes grow well in sunny places.
examples.zh: 玫瑰花丛在阳光充足的地方长得很好。

examples.en: A rose petal fell from the flower.
examples.zh: 一片玫瑰花瓣从花上落了下来。

examples.en: She sent him a bunch of red roses.
examples.zh: 她送了他一束红玫瑰。

examples.en: We made beautiful flowers with coloured paper in art class.
examples.zh: 我们在美术课上用彩纸做了漂亮的花朵。

examples.en: Please cut the coloured paper into small squares for the project.
examples.zh: 请把彩纸剪成小方块用于这个手工项目。

examples.en: She used red and blue coloured paper to make a card for her mom.
examples.zh: 她用红色和蓝色的彩纸给妈妈做了一张卡片。

examples.en: My teacher uses magnetic tape for the old music player.
examples.zh: 我的老师用磁带给旧音乐播放器放音乐。

examples.en: I have that film on tape for you to watch.
examples.zh: 我有那部电影的录像带，你可以看。

examples.en: Please give me a blank tape, and I’ll record it for you.
examples.zh: 请给我一盘空白带，我会帮你录下来。

examples.en: There is a blob of glue on my desk.
examples.zh: 我的书桌上有一团胶水。

examples.en: Use strong glue to join the two pieces.
examples.zh: 用强力胶把两片粘在一起。

examples.en: The parts stick together with glue.
examples.zh: 这些零件用胶水粘在一起。

examples.en: She folded the letter in half and put it in the bag.
examples.zh: 她把信对折，然后放进了包里。

examples.en: His neatly folded coat was on the chair.
examples.zh: 他那件叠得整整齐齐的外套放在椅子上。

examples.en: Can you help me fold up the towels?
examples.zh: 你能帮我把毛巾叠起来吗？

examples.en: Complete this sentence with the right word.
examples.zh: 用正确的词完成这个句子。

examples.en: He needs two more cards to complete the set.
examples.zh: 他需要再有两张卡片才能凑齐整套。

examples.en: A baby would complete her happiness.
examples.zh: 一个宝宝会让她的幸福变得完整。

examples.en: He is a DIY enthusiast and loves fixing things.
examples.zh: 他是个DIY爱好者，喜欢修理东西。

examples.en: We are working on a DIY project together.
examples.zh: 我们一起在做一个小手工项目。

examples.en: The old owners were very keen on DIY and changed a lot.
examples.zh: 旧房主非常爱自己动手，改了很多地方。

examples.en: My brother likes do-it-yourself projects at home.
examples.zh: 我哥哥喜欢在家自己做手工活。

examples.en: She did a do-it-yourself repair for her bike.
examples.zh: 她对自己的自行车做了自己动手的修理。

examples.en: We can make a do-it-yourself card for Mom's birthday.
examples.zh: 我们可以亲手做一张卡片给妈妈过生日。

examples.en: It's a crazy idea.
examples.zh: 这是个疯狂的主意。

examples.en: You're crazy to buy a house without seeing it.
examples.zh: 你没看房子就买，真是疯了。

examples.en: Some people are crazy and don't see what's bad for them.
examples.zh: 有些人很疯狂，看不出什么对他们不好。

examples.en: My sister is crazy about collecting stamps.
examples.zh: 我妹妹热衷于集邮。

examples.en: He is crazy about playing basketball after school.
examples.zh: 他放学后热衷于打篮球。

examples.en: They are crazy about watching English movies.
examples.zh: 他们热衷于看英文电影。

examples.en: She was born in 1950.
examples.zh: 她出生于1950年。

examples.en: More babies are born with AIDS now.
examples.zh: 现在更多婴儿一出生就带着艾滋病。

examples.en: Stevie Wonder was born blind.
examples.zh: 史蒂维·旺德天生失明。

examples.en: My uncle is a handyman who can fix anything at home.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是个手巧的人，家里什么东西都能修。

examples.en: The handyman painted the wall and repaired the broken chair.
examples.zh: 那个手巧的人刷了墙，还修好了坏椅子。

examples.en: She hired a handyman to help with small jobs around the house.
examples.zh: 她雇了个手巧的人帮忙做家里的零活。

examples.en: Don't blame yourself. We all make mistakes.
examples.zh: 别责怪自己。我们都会犯错。

examples.en: Coming here tonight was a big mistake for us.
examples.zh: 今晚来这儿对我们来说是个大错误。

examples.en: This letter has many spelling mistakes.
examples.zh: 这封信里有很多拼写错误。

examples.en: The storm caused a power cut in many homes last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚暴风雨导致许多家庭停电。

examples.en: We had a power cut during the big storm yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天大暴雨时我们停电了。

examples.en: A power cut happened in our town for two hours.
examples.zh: 我们镇上停电了两个小时。

examples.en: The water pipe in the kitchen is leaking.
examples.zh: 厨房里的水管正在漏水。

examples.en: A broken gas pipe is very dangerous.
examples.zh: 破裂的煤气管非常危险。

examples.en: Water came out from the old pipe slowly.
examples.zh: 水从旧管子里慢慢流出来。

examples.en: She filled the cup with hot tea.
examples.zh: 她用热茶把杯子倒满了。

examples.en: Please fill the box with old books.
examples.zh: 请把这个箱子装满旧书。

examples.en: The loud music filled the room with joy.
examples.zh: 响亮的音乐使房间里充满了欢乐。

examples.en: The couple were unlucky to be in the hotel during the attack.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇很不幸，袭击发生时正在酒店里。

examples.en: She is one of the unluckiest people I know.
examples.zh: 她是我认识的最不幸的人之一。

examples.en: The unlucky people lost at sea were remembered when the ship arrived.
examples.zh: 那些在海上失踪的不幸者，在船到达时被大家纪念。

examples.en: We have no coffee. Would you like tea instead?
examples.zh: 我们没有咖啡了。你要喝茶吗？

examples.en: I will stop yoga and do aerobics instead.
examples.zh: 我要放弃瑜伽，改做有氧操。

examples.en: They knocked down the old building and made a car park instead.
examples.zh: 他们拆掉了那座旧楼，反而建了个停车场。

examples.en: They will go on a training course next week.
examples.zh: 他们下周要去参加一个培训课程。

examples.en: I want to do a writing course after I stop working.
examples.zh: 我停止工作后想上一个写作课程。

examples.en: She soon began to take courses to help people's backs.
examples.zh: 她不久开始上课，学习帮助人们治疗背部的方法。

examples.en: Don't make a mess in your room.
examples.zh: 别把你的房间弄得一团糟。

examples.en: My desk is always in a mess.
examples.zh: 我的书桌总是一团乱。

examples.en: Please clean up this mess now.
examples.zh: 请现在把这乱七八糟的东西收拾干净。

examples.en: My desk is in a mess with many books on it.
examples.zh: 我的书桌乱七八糟，上面堆了很多书。

examples.en: The kitchen was in a mess after the party.
examples.zh: 聚会后厨房乱成一团。

examples.en: His hair is in a mess because of the strong wind.
examples.zh: 他的头发被大风吹得乱七八糟。

examples.en: There is an electric lamp on the desk.
examples.zh: 书桌上有一盏电灯。

examples.en: The street lamp is very bright at night.
examples.zh: 夜晚的路灯很亮。

examples.en: I read with my bedside lamp before sleep.
examples.zh: 睡觉前我用床头灯读书。

examples.en: The red dress in the shop window caught her eye.
examples.zh: 橱窗里的红裙子引起了她的注意。

examples.en: A bright poster on the wall caught my eye.
examples.zh: 墙上的一张亮眼海报吸引了我的目光。

examples.en: His funny hat caught everyone's eye at the party.
examples.zh: 他那顶滑稽的帽子在聚会上引起了所有人的注意。

examples.en: We were very surprised at the result.
examples.zh: 我们对这个结果感到非常惊讶。

examples.en: Alice, I'm surprised at you for doing this.
examples.zh: 爱丽丝，你这样做让我很意外。

examples.en: I'm not surprised he didn't keep his word.
examples.zh: 他没遵守诺言，我一点也不意外。

examples.en: It was impossible to sleep with so much noise.
examples.zh: 噪音太大，不可能睡得着。

examples.en: It seems impossible that I didn't see her.
examples.zh: 我没看到她，这似乎是不可能的。

examples.en: He made it impossible for me to say no.
examples.zh: 他让我没法说不。

examples.en: We bought a tin of paint for the wall.
examples.zh: 我们为墙壁买了一罐油漆。

examples.en: He opened a can of paint and began to work.
examples.zh: 他打开一罐油漆，然后开始干活。

examples.en: The wall needs a new coat of paint.
examples.zh: 这面墙需要再刷一层油漆。

examples.en: Can you see the can on the table?
examples.zh: 你能看到桌上的那个罐子吗？

examples.en: She can open the plastic can easily.
examples.zh: 她能轻松打开那个塑料罐。

examples.en: Can you recycle this metal can at school?
examples.zh: 你能在学校回收这个金属罐吗？

examples.en: His kids go everywhere with him.
examples.zh: 他的孩子们到处跟着他。

examples.en: Everything looks grey and sad everywhere in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天到处看起来灰蒙蒙的，让人难过。

examples.en: I searched everywhere for my keys.
examples.zh: 我到处找我的钥匙。

examples.en: He took a piece of chalk and wrote the answer.
examples.zh: 他拿起一支粉笔写下了答案。

examples.en: The teacher drew a map with colorful chalk.
examples.zh: 老师用彩色粉笔画了一幅地图。

examples.en: Please write the new words in chalk on the board.
examples.zh: 请用粉笔把新单词写在黑板上。

examples.en: She wiped her hands and left dirty marks on her trousers.
examples.zh: 她擦了擦手，裤子上留下了脏印记。

examples.en: His fingers left marks on the shiny table.
examples.zh: 他的手指在光亮的桌子上留下了印记。

examples.en: She burned her arm and now has a red mark.
examples.zh: 她烫伤了胳膊，现在有一块红印。

examples.en: My brush is lost, but I still have my comb.
examples.zh: 我的刷子丢了，但我还有梳子。

examples.en: Use a stiff brush to clean the rust.
examples.zh: 用一把硬刷子来清除锈迹。

examples.en: She cleans her coat with a clothes brush.
examples.zh: 她用衣服刷子清洁她的外套。

examples.en: They need clear instructions on what to do next.
examples.zh: 他们需要关于下一步做什么的清晰说明。

examples.en: The instructions for building this cupboard are useless.
examples.zh: 组装这个柜子的说明毫无用处。

examples.en: The cooking instructions say to bake it for 30 minutes.
examples.zh: 烹饪说明写着要烤三十分钟。

examples.en: Don't touch those dangerous chemicals in the lab.
examples.zh: 别碰实验室里那些危险的化学品。

examples.en: The robbers are armed and dangerous, so stay away.
examples.zh: 劫匪有武器且很危险，所以离远点。

examples.en: His parents say ice hockey is too dangerous for him.
examples.zh: 他父母说冰球对他来说太危险了。

examples.en: I slept at my usual time last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚在平常的时间睡觉了。

examples.en: This summer had more rain than usual in the mountains.
examples.zh: 今年夏天山里的雨比往常多。

examples.en: You can find the forks in their usual spot.
examples.zh: 你能在通常的地方找到叉子。

examples.en: My grandma's photos show her in tie-dyed shirts.
examples.zh: 我奶奶的照片里，她穿着扎染衬衫。

examples.en: He made a cool tie-dye bag for his sister.
examples.zh: 他给妹妹做了一个很酷的扎染包。

examples.en: We learned how to tie-dye old T-shirts in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上学会了怎么给旧T恤扎染。

examples.en: The road twists and turns for a long way.
examples.zh: 这条路弯弯曲曲，延伸得很远。

examples.en: She twisted her ring on her finger nervously.
examples.zh: 她紧张地扭动着手指上的戒指。

examples.en: She twisted her head to see what was happening.
examples.zh: 她扭过头去看发生了什么。

examples.en: I need a piece of cloth to make a bag.
examples.zh: 我需要一块布来做袋子。

examples.en: She wiped the table with a cleaning cloth.
examples.zh: 她用一块清洁布擦了桌子。

examples.en: Please lay the cloth flat on the table.
examples.zh: 请把布料平铺在桌子上。

examples.en: Could you tie the string for me?
examples.zh: 你能帮我系一下这根绳子吗？

examples.en: This skirt ties at the waist.
examples.zh: 这条裙子在腰部系带。

examples.en: She tied the ribbon in a bow.
examples.zh: 她把丝带系成了一个蝴蝶结。

examples.en: Do you have a needle and thread I can borrow?
examples.zh: 你有针线可以借我吗？

examples.en: Be careful, there are loose threads on your shirt.
examples.zh: 小心，你衬衫上有几根松掉的线头。

examples.en: A thin thread of light came through the curtains.
examples.zh: 一缕细光穿过窗帘照了进来。

examples.en: Why not dye your old T-shirt a new color?
examples.zh: 为什么不把你的旧T恤染个新颜色呢？

examples.en: He dyed his hair black for the party.
examples.zh: 他为了聚会把头发染成了黑色。

examples.en: She put the cloth into the blue dye.
examples.zh: 她把布放进蓝色染液里。

examples.en: The knot is too tight, so I can't untie it.
examples.zh: 这个结太紧了，所以我解不开它。

examples.en: He untied his shoelaces before changing his shoes.
examples.zh: 他在换鞋前解开了鞋带。

examples.en: I helped her untie her shoelaces yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我帮她解开了鞋带。

examples.en: Taking the train is a safe travel method.
examples.zh: 坐火车是一种安全的旅行方法。

examples.en: These new teaching methods help kids think by themselves.
examples.zh: 这些新教学方法帮助孩子们自己思考。

examples.en: That method didn't work, so let's use yours.
examples.zh: 那个方法没用，所以我们用你的吧。

examples.en: They make many skin-care products.
examples.zh: 他们生产许多护肤产品。

examples.en: This product is so good that it sells well.
examples.zh: 这个产品非常好，卖得很好。

examples.en: I want to eat fewer dairy products.
examples.zh: 我想少吃一些乳制品。

examples.en: She not only sings well but also dances beautifully.
examples.zh: 她不仅歌唱得好，而且舞也跳得美。

examples.en: He not only finished his homework but also helped his sister.
examples.zh: 他不仅完成了作业，还帮了他妹妹。

examples.en: The movie is not only exciting but also moving.
examples.zh: 这部电影不仅刺激，而且感人。

examples.en: My uncle has a small carpenter's workshop behind his house.
examples.zh: 我叔叔的房子后面有一个小木工作坊。

examples.en: We visited an engineering workshop where workers make machines.
examples.zh: 我们参观了一个制作机器的工程作坊。

examples.en: Our school holds a training workshop for making model planes.
examples.zh: 我们学校举办了一个制作飞机模型的培训工作坊。

examples.en: I put his wet pants near the fire, but they are still not dry.
examples.zh: 我把他湿裤子放在火边，但它们还没干。

examples.en: This cake tastes a bit dry because I baked it too long.
examples.zh: 这蛋糕尝起来有点干，因为我烤太久了。

examples.en: These plants grow well in dry soil, so don't water them too much.
examples.zh: 这些植物在干土里长得好，所以别浇太多水。

examples.en: The pattern of family life is changing now.
examples.zh: 家庭生活的模式现在正在改变。

examples.en: A clear pattern is starting to show in the accident data.
examples.zh: 事故数据中开始显示出一种清晰的模式。

examples.en: This illness often has a pattern of sad and happy times.
examples.zh: 这种病常常有悲伤和快乐交替出现的模式。

examples.en: The ball rolled off the table and broke.
examples.zh: 球从桌上滚下来摔破了。

examples.en: The dog rolled over on its back.
examples.zh: 狗翻了个身，露出了肚子。

examples.en: I rolled the tire back to the car on the road.
examples.zh: 我沿着路把轮胎滚回了车旁。

examples.en: Do big bombs really reduce the danger of war?
examples.zh: 大炸弹真的能减少战争的危险吗？

examples.en: The plane reduced its speed near the airport.
examples.zh: 飞机在靠近机场时减速了。

examples.en: I reduce my weight when I don't eat sugar.
examples.zh: 我不吃糖时体重就会减少。

examples.en: The meeting was a complete waste of time.
examples.zh: 那个会议完全是浪费时间。

examples.en: She is out of work, and it's a waste of her talent.
examples.zh: 她失业了，这对她的才华来说是一种浪费。

examples.en: My mom hated waste and made us eat all our food.
examples.zh: 我妈妈讨厌浪费，她让我们把食物都吃光。

examples.en: They were full of joy when their first baby was born.
examples.zh: 第一个孩子出生时，他们心中充满了喜悦。

examples.en: She cried with joy when she learned her husband was alive.
examples.zh: 当她得知丈夫还活着时，她高兴得哭了。

examples.en: Listening to music brings him great joy.
examples.zh: 听音乐给他带来很大的乐趣。

examples.en: I need a pair of leather gloves for winter.
examples.zh: 冬天我需要一副皮手套。

examples.en: She bought new rubber gloves for washing dishes.
examples.zh: 她买了新橡胶手套来洗碗。

examples.en: He wears gardening gloves when he works in the garden.
examples.zh: 他在花园干活时戴着园艺手套。

examples.en: Her fingers are long and beautiful.
examples.zh: 她的手指又长又漂亮。

examples.en: I cut my finger while cutting onions last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我切洋葱时割伤了手指。

examples.en: A big diamond ring shone on her finger.
examples.zh: 一枚大钻戒在她手指上闪闪发光。

examples.en: I buttoned up my blouse quickly.
examples.zh: 我很快扣上了衬衫的纽扣。

examples.en: He opened his top button.
examples.zh: 他解开了最上面的纽扣。

examples.en: I sewed a new button on my trousers.
examples.zh: 我在裤子上缝了一颗新纽扣。

examples.en: I slipped when I got onto the train.
examples.zh: 我上火车时滑倒了。

examples.en: The workers put the sheep onto the trucks.
examples.zh: 工人们把羊装上了卡车。

examples.en: She threw oil onto the fire, and it flared up.
examples.zh: 她把油泼到火上，火就烧旺了。

examples.en: A wild animal like a bear can't be happy in a cage.
examples.zh: 像熊这样的野生动物在笼子里不会开心。

examples.en: People should never keep a wild beast as a pet.
examples.zh: 人们绝不应该把野兽当宠物养。

examples.en: We must protect wild creatures and their homes.
examples.zh: 我们必须保护野生动物和它们的家园。

examples.en: People studied dolphins and then made submarines to swim fast and stay underwater long.
examples.zh: 人们研究了海豚，然后制造了潜艇，让它们游得快并长时间待在水下。

examples.en: Dolphins swim fast in water, but that is not just to stay safe.
examples.zh: 海豚在水里游得快，但这不仅仅是为了安全。

examples.en: Dolphins use their tails to go faster and fins to turn around.
examples.zh: 海豚用尾巴游得更快，用鳍来转身。

examples.en: The eagle flew high above the mountain without any sound.
examples.zh: 那只雕在山上方无声地飞得很高。

examples.en: We watched the eagle fly down fast to get its food.
examples.zh: 我们看着那只雕快速飞下来抓它的食物。

examples.en: She made an eagle in the game, so she was only one behind.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中抓了一只雕，所以只落后一分。

examples.en: The hunters ran after the fox until it was too tired to run.
examples.zh: 猎人追赶狐狸，直到它累得跑不动了。

examples.en: The dogs lost the fox's smell by the river.
examples.zh: 狗在河边闻不到狐狸的气味了。

examples.en: When the fox came into the yard, the chickens cried out in fear.
examples.zh: 当狐狸走进院子时，鸡害怕地叫起来。

examples.en: A great white shark is very big and strong.
examples.zh: 大白鲨非常大且强壮。

examples.en: A basking shark swims slowly near the water top.
examples.zh: 姥鲨在水面附近慢慢游动。

examples.en: The movie "Jaws" tells a story about a shark that eats people.
examples.zh: 电影《大白鲨》讲的是一条吃人的鲨鱼的故事。

examples.en: Wolves hunt together in groups called packs.
examples.zh: 狼成群结队地一起捕猎。

examples.en: We heard wolves howling far away at night.
examples.zh: 我们晚上听到狼在远处嚎叫。

examples.en: In the quiet night, a lone wolf howled.
examples.zh: 在安静的夜里，一只孤独的狼嚎叫了。

examples.en: A baby zebra can walk 15 minutes after birth.
examples.zh: 斑马宝宝出生15分钟后就能走路。

examples.en: One idea: many zebras running together make a confusing pattern.
examples.zh: 一个想法是：许多斑马一起跑动形成令人迷惑的图案。

examples.en: Another idea: zebra stripes hide them in grass because lions can't see colors.
examples.zh: 另一个想法是：斑马条纹把它们藏在草里，因为狮子看不见颜色。

examples.en: King Richard II ruled England long ago.
examples.zh: 理查二世国王很久以前统治过英格兰。

examples.en: The kings and queens of England lived in big palaces.
examples.zh: 英格兰的国王和王后们住在大的宫殿里。

examples.en: Prince Juan Carlos became king of Spain in 1975.
examples.zh: 胡安·卡洛斯王子在1975年成为了西班牙国王。

examples.en: Look at the tiny flower in the grass.
examples.zh: 看草地上的那朵极小的花。

examples.en: He ate a tiny helping of rice.
examples.zh: 他只吃了一点点米饭。

examples.en: The tiny baby is sleeping in the bed.
examples.zh: 那个极小的婴儿正在床上睡觉。

examples.en: The baby's birth was very hard for his mother.
examples.zh: 这个婴儿的出生对他母亲来说很艰难。

examples.en: He weighed eight pounds at birth.
examples.zh: 他出生时重八磅。

examples.en: Now more fathers are at their children's birth.
examples.zh: 现在更多父亲在孩子出生时在场。

examples.en: He is very sick and needs round-the-clock care.
examples.zh: 他病得很重，需要全天候的照顾。

examples.en: He studied round-the-clock and lost forty pounds.
examples.zh: 他没日没夜地学习，瘦了四十磅。

examples.en: He needs round-the-clock care from a nurse.
examples.zh: 他需要护士全天候的照顾。

examples.en: The big bag weighs about ten kilograms.
examples.zh: 这个大袋子大约重十公斤。

examples.en: The doctor weighed the baby after the check-up.
examples.zh: 检查之后，医生给婴儿称了体重。

examples.en: I am weighing the apple in my hand.
examples.zh: 我正在用手掂量这个苹果的重量。

examples.en: We had a satisfying meal at the new restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们在新餐厅吃了一顿令人满意的饭。

examples.en: Helping others is a satisfying job for me.
examples.zh: 帮助别人对我来说是一份令人满意的工作。

examples.en: It is satisfying to see the project was a success.
examples.zh: 看到项目成功，真令人满意。

examples.en: The giant panda is black and white and eats bamboo.
examples.zh: 大熊猫是黑白相间的，吃竹子。

examples.en: We saw a cute giant panda at the zoo yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们昨天在动物园看到一只可爱的大熊猫。

examples.en: The giant panda usually sleeps for more than ten hours a day.
examples.zh: 大熊猫通常每天睡觉超过十个小时。

examples.en: We should not feed wild animals in the wild.
examples.zh: 我们不应该在野外喂食野生动物。

examples.en: Pandas live in the wild in the mountains of China.
examples.zh: 熊猫生活在中国山区的野外。

examples.en: It is hard for pets to survive in the wild.
examples.zh: 宠物很难在野外生存。

examples.en: He has a serious illness and needs rest.
examples.zh: 他得了重病，需要休息。

examples.en: No one had serious injuries in the accident.
examples.zh: 事故中没有人受重伤。

examples.en: The new tax rules caused serious trouble for small companies.
examples.zh: 新税收规定给小公司带来了严重的麻烦。

examples.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, we will still go hiking.
examples.zh: 即使明天下雨，我们仍然会去远足。

examples.en: She won't give up even if she fails the test.
examples.zh: 即使考试不及格，她也不会放弃。

examples.en: Even if you are busy, please call me tonight.
examples.zh: 即使你很忙，今晚也请给我打电话。

examples.en: If you want, I can easily get home early tonight.
examples.zh: 如果你愿意，我今晚很容易就能早点到家。

examples.en: The water is only knee-deep, so we can easily cross the river.
examples.zh: 水只有齐膝深，所以我们能轻松过河。

examples.en: You can easily find the information about this on the internet.
examples.zh: 你能在网上很容易找到关于这个的信息。

examples.en: The sick child needs to see a doctor.
examples.zh: 这个生病的孩子需要看医生。

examples.en: The sick cow is lying in the field.
examples.zh: 那头生病的奶牛正躺在田野里。

examples.en: My father has been sick and off work for a long time.
examples.zh: 我父亲生病了，已经很久没去上班了。

examples.en: Pandas live on bamboo in the mountains.
examples.zh: 熊猫在山上以竹子为生。

examples.en: We can live on rice and vegetables every day.
examples.zh: 我们每天可以靠米饭和蔬菜为生。

examples.en: Birds live on seeds and small insects.
examples.zh: 鸟儿靠种子和小虫子为生。

examples.en: I mainly sleep at about 12 o'clock at night.
examples.zh: 我主要是在晚上十二点左右睡觉。

examples.en: The group has mainly young people in it.
examples.zh: 这个团体里主要是年轻人。

examples.en: They said the tax will mainly help rich people.
examples.zh: 他们说这项税主要会帮助富人。

examples.en: The road is wider now, but the result is more cars.
examples.zh: 路现在更宽了，但结果是更多汽车。

examples.en: His broken leg is the result of his carelessness.
examples.zh: 他的断腿是他粗心的结果。

examples.en: I repainted the kitchen, with bad results.
examples.zh: 我重新粉刷了厨房，结果很糟糕。

examples.en: He studied hard every day. As a result, he passed the exam.
examples.zh: 他每天努力学习。因此，他通过了考试。

examples.en: It rained heavily last night. As a result, the ground is wet.
examples.zh: 昨晚雨下得很大。因此，地面是湿的。

examples.en: She forgot to set the alarm. As a result, she was late for school.
examples.zh: 她忘了设闹钟。因此，她上学迟到了。

examples.en: The Israeli government works for its people.
examples.zh: 以色列政府为人民服务。

examples.en: The government will tell us its tax plan today.
examples.zh: 政府今天会告诉我们它的税收计划。

examples.en: The minister said the government policy will not change.
examples.zh: 部长说政府政策不会改变。

examples.en: We must take quick action to protect our climate.
examples.zh: 我们必须采取快速行动来保护气候。

examples.en: The government needs to take swift action on this problem.
examples.zh: 政府需要就这个问题采取迅速的行动。

examples.en: Action to stop the disease is very important for the government.
examples.zh: 阻止疾病传播的行动对政府来说非常重要。

examples.en: We must take action to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 我们必须采取行动保护环境。

examples.en: The government took action to stop the pollution.
examples.zh: 政府采取行动阻止污染。

examples.en: If you see a problem, please take action at once.
examples.zh: 如果你看到问题，请立刻采取行动。

examples.en: We saw many wild animals in the nature reserve last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末我们在自然保护区看到了许多野生动物。

examples.en: The nature reserve protects rare plants and birds from danger.
examples.zh: 自然保护区保护珍稀植物和鸟类免受危险。

examples.en: Visitors must not pick flowers in the nature reserve.
examples.zh: 游客禁止在自然保护区摘花。

examples.en: Thanks to your help, I finished my homework on time.
examples.zh: 多亏了你的帮助，我按时完成了作业。

examples.en: Thanks to the nice weather, we can play football today.
examples.zh: 由于天气很好，我们今天能踢足球了。

examples.en: Thanks to my father's car, we arrived at the station early.
examples.zh: 多亏了我爸爸的车，我们早早到了车站。

examples.en: If we all make an effort to keep the office tidy, it will help.
examples.zh: 如果我们都努力保持办公室整洁，那会有帮助的。

examples.en: You won't make friends if you don't make an effort with people.
examples.zh: 如果你不努力和别人交往，你就交不到朋友。

examples.en: In their effort to reduce crime, the government added more police.
examples.zh: 为了努力减少犯罪，政府增加了更多警察。

examples.en: The number of robberies has increased in recent years.
examples.zh: 抢劫事件的数量在近几年增加了。

examples.en: The cost of the project has increased a lot since it started.
examples.zh: 项目开始以来，成本增加了很多。

examples.en: Tourism to Antarctica has increased greatly in the past ten years.
examples.zh: 去南极的旅游业在过去十年里大大增加了。

examples.en: Their weak tent gave little protection against the big storm.
examples.zh: 他们那顶不结实的帐篷几乎无法抵御大风暴。

examples.en: All top politicians get 24-hour police protection.
examples.zh: 所有高级政客都受到警察全天候保护。

examples.en: New laws still don't give enough protection for many rare animals.
examples.zh: 新法律仍然没有为许多珍稀动物提供足够的保护。

examples.en: A healthy diet helps kids' growth.
examples.zh: 健康的饮食有助于孩子的成长。

examples.en: Plants show fast growth in spring.
examples.zh: 植物在春天生长很快。

examples.en: The city wants to slow down its growth.
examples.zh: 这个城市想放慢它的发展速度。

examples.en: Kids teased for being fat feel worse about themselves.
examples.zh: 因为胖而被嘲笑的孩子自我感觉更差。

examples.en: He eats all day but never gets fat.
examples.zh: 他整天吃东西，但从不发胖。

examples.en: Feeding cows grain makes them grow fatter fast.
examples.zh: 给奶牛喂谷物会让它们很快长胖。

examples.en: Did you manage to buy any bread?
examples.zh: 你买到面包了吗？

examples.en: I only just managed to finish on time.
examples.zh: 我刚好按时完成了。

examples.en: A small dog managed to stay alive in the fire.
examples.zh: 一只小狗在火灾中活了下来。

examples.en: Whale oil was used for lamps in the past.
examples.zh: 过去鲸油被用来点灯。

examples.en: Whales can talk to each other very well.
examples.zh: 鲸鱼能很好地互相交流。

examples.en: Many countries work to stop killing whales.
examples.zh: 许多国家努力阻止捕杀鲸鱼。

examples.en: Some animals hunt at night.
examples.zh: 有些动物在夜晚猎食。

examples.en: The father lion hunts for food for the cubs.
examples.zh: 雄狮为幼狮猎取食物。

examples.en: Jack and Charlie often go hunting on weekends.
examples.zh: 杰克和查理周末常去打猎。

examples.en: They shared a meaningful look.
examples.zh: 他们交换了一个重要的眼神。

examples.en: He gave me a meaningful smile.
examples.zh: 他给了我一个意味深长的微笑。

examples.en: We should make meaningful friends in life.
examples.zh: 生活中我们应该交重要的朋友。

examples.en: The little bird is in danger because the forest is on fire.
examples.zh: 那只小鸟处于危险中，因为森林着火了。

examples.en: Many wild animals are in danger, so we must protect them.
examples.zh: 许多野生动物处于危险中，所以我们必须保护它们。

examples.en: Don't swim there, you will be in danger.
examples.zh: 别在那里游泳，你会有危险的。

examples.en: The reason for the fire was a broken wire.
examples.zh: 火灾的原因是电线断了。

examples.en: The reason why the sky is blue still puzzles Tom.
examples.zh: 天空为什么是蓝色的，仍然让汤姆困惑。

examples.en: The reason I come here is to say sorry.
examples.zh: 我来这里的理由是说声对不起。

examples.en: Do you accept credit cards here?
examples.zh: 你们这里收信用卡吗？

examples.en: She went to Mumbai to accept an award for her new book.
examples.zh: 她去孟买领了她新书的奖。

examples.en: I said sorry to her, but she didn't accept it.
examples.zh: 我跟她道了歉，但她不接受。

examples.en: A polar bear's white fur hides it well in snow.
examples.zh: 北极熊的白色皮毛让它在雪中很隐蔽。

examples.en: Polar bears on the ice may die.
examples.zh: 冰上的北极熊可能会死去。

examples.en: Polar bears have sharp claws and teeth.
examples.zh: 北极熊有锋利的爪子和牙齿。

examples.en: They really think they can make meat eaters become vegetarians.
examples.zh: 他们真的觉得能让肉食者变成素食者。

examples.en: He loves meat and is a big meat eater, especially steak.
examples.zh: 他爱吃肉，是个大肉食者，尤其喜欢牛排。

examples.en: They are vegetarians, but they also cook for meat eaters.
examples.zh: 他们是素食者，但也为肉食者做饭。

examples.en: The snow usually melts by March.
examples.zh: 雪通常在三月前融化。

examples.en: Melt the chocolate slowly to stop it burning.
examples.zh: 慢慢融化巧克力，防止它烧焦。

examples.en: The soft cake melts in your mouth.
examples.zh: 这块软蛋糕入口即化。

examples.en: She dropped her keys on the floor.
examples.zh: 她把钥匙掉在了地上。

examples.en: I always drop things by accident.
examples.zh: 我总是不小心掉东西。

examples.en: Amanda dropped her sunglasses in the fountain.
examples.zh: 阿曼达把太阳镜掉进了喷泉里。

examples.en: The blue whale makes one of the loudest sounds on earth.
examples.zh: 蓝鲸发出地球上最响亮的声音之一。

examples.en: People saw four blue whales in the area recently.
examples.zh: 人们最近在这个地区看到了四头蓝鲸。

examples.en: Blue whales are long, thin, and can be 100 feet long.
examples.zh: 蓝鲸又长又细，可以长达100英尺。

examples.en: In this job, the risks and rewards are both high.
examples.zh: 在这份工作中，风险和回报都很高。

examples.en: There is a high risk of another car accident in this fog.
examples.zh: 在这场雾里，发生另一起车祸的风险很高。

examples.en: The risk of failing made us work twice as hard.
examples.zh: 失败的风险让我们加倍努力。

examples.en: Many wild animals are at risk because of hunting.
examples.zh: 许多野生动物因捕猎而处于危险中。

examples.en: People who smoke are at risk of getting sick.
examples.zh: 吸烟的人有生病的危险。

examples.en: The old bridge is at risk of falling down.
examples.zh: 那座旧桥有倒塌的危险。

examples.en: My friend is from an Indian family.
examples.zh: 我的朋友来自一个印度家庭。

examples.en: The Indian ambassador visited our school.
examples.zh: 印度大使参观了我们的学校。

examples.en: She knows an Indian family next door.
examples.zh: 她认识隔壁的一个印度家庭。

examples.en: A rhino has a big horn on its nose.
examples.zh: 犀牛鼻子上有一个大角。

examples.en: Some rhinos get sick from tiny fungi in the air.
examples.zh: 有些犀牛会因空气中的微小真菌而生病。

examples.en: Can you find a good doctor for a rhino's nose?
examples.zh: 你能为犀牛的鼻子找个好医生吗？

examples.en: The bull put its horns down and ran at him.
examples.zh: 公牛低下角，朝他冲了过来。

examples.en: The male deer has big horns on its head.
examples.zh: 公鹿头上长着大大的角。

examples.en: The knife handle was made of animal horn.
examples.zh: 这把刀柄是用动物的角做的。

examples.en: They are looking into the recent rail disaster.
examples.zh: 他们正在调查最近的铁路灾难。

examples.en: Losing my job would be a disaster for me.
examples.zh: 失去工作对我来说将是一场灾难。

examples.en: This is one of the worst natural disasters here.
examples.zh: 这是这里最严重的自然灾害之一。

examples.en: Air and water pollution are bad for our health.
examples.zh: 空气污染和水污染对我们的健康有害。

examples.en: The new plan has strong ways to fight traffic and environmental pollution.
examples.zh: 新计划有强硬的办法来应对交通和环境污染。

examples.en: The company says it is not responsible for the river pollution.
examples.zh: 这家公司说它对河流污染不负责任。

examples.en: Are you certain that you gave them the right number?
examples.zh: 你确定你给了他们正确的号码吗？

examples.en: I feel certain that you are doing the right thing.
examples.zh: 我觉得你做得对。

examples.en: Make certain everyone understands the instructions.
examples.zh: 确保每个人都明白这些说明。

examples.en: He died at home after a long illness.
examples.zh: 他在长期患病后于家中去世。

examples.en: She took five days off because of illness.
examples.zh: 她因病请了五天假。

examples.en: We have three staff away due to illness.
examples.zh: 我们有三位员工因病缺席。

examples.en: It was a cold and foggy day.
examples.zh: 那是一个寒冷有雾的日子。

examples.en: The city is often foggy and humid in spring.
examples.zh: 这座城市春天常常有雾而且潮湿。

examples.en: What a foggy day! I can't see the road clearly.
examples.zh: 好大的雾啊！我看不清路。

examples.en: This winter has been very snowy in our city.
examples.zh: 今年冬天我们城市下了很多雪。

examples.en: The snowy mountain looks beautiful in the morning.
examples.zh: 被雪覆盖的山在早晨看起来很美丽。

examples.en: My grandpa has a snowy-white beard and kind eyes.
examples.zh: 我爷爷有一把雪白的胡子和慈祥的眼睛。

examples.en: The weather here is pleasant and sunny.
examples.zh: 这里的天气令人愉快，阳光明媚。

examples.en: We had a pleasant surprise at the party.
examples.zh: 我们在聚会上得到了一个令人愉快的惊喜。

examples.en: Harold tried to be pleasant to the old man.
examples.zh: 哈罗德试着对那位老人态度友好。

examples.en: Yeah, I like my job and it's OK.
examples.zh: 是的，我喜欢我的工作，它还不错。

examples.en: Yeah, I will drive, sure.
examples.zh: 是的，我会开车，当然。

examples.en: Yeah, I enjoyed the film, it was great.
examples.zh: 是的，我喜欢这部电影，它很棒。

examples.en: She often hid her diary under her pillow.
examples.zh: 她经常把日记藏在枕头下面。

examples.en: The bag had a hidden pocket with drugs in it.
examples.zh: 包里有一个藏着毒品的暗袋。

examples.en: I like sunglasses because I can hide behind them.
examples.zh: 我喜欢墨镜，因为我能躲在它们后面。

examples.en: The shower is broken, so you need to take a bath.
examples.zh: 淋浴器坏了，所以你需要洗个澡。

examples.en: Many British homes have a shower on the bath taps.
examples.zh: 许多英国家庭在浴缸龙头上装有淋浴器。

examples.en: Where can I find a shower curtain that won't get mouldy?
examples.zh: 我在哪里能找到一条底部不会发霉的浴帘？

examples.en: He has a good memory for faces.
examples.zh: 他对人脸有很好的记忆力。

examples.en: I have a bad memory, so I forgot the address.
examples.zh: 我记性不好，所以忘了地址。

examples.en: After the accident, he had memory loss.
examples.zh: 事故之后，他失去了记忆。

examples.en: After our walk, we cooled off in a mountain stream.
examples.zh: 我们走完路后，在山间小溪里凉快了一下。

examples.en: An underground stream runs below the hill.
examples.zh: 一条地下小溪从山丘下面流过。

examples.en: A small stream flows through their yard.
examples.zh: 一条小溪流过他们的院子。

examples.en: The sun was hot, but we had no trees for shade.
examples.zh: 太阳很晒，但我们没有树荫可乘凉。

examples.en: We sat in the shade of some tall trees.
examples.zh: 我们坐在一些大树的树荫下。

examples.en: Stay in the shade and drink much water.
examples.zh: 待在树荫里，多喝水。

examples.en: The manager said the workers were lazy and not reliable.
examples.zh: 经理说工人们懒惰且不可靠。

examples.en: Get up now, you lazy boy!
examples.zh: 现在起床，你这个懒孩子！

examples.en: He is too lazy to walk to his office.
examples.zh: 他太懒了，不愿走路去办公室。

examples.en: I spent most of my holiday by the pool.
examples.zh: 我假期大部分时间都待在游泳池边。

examples.en: I just want to lie by the pool and relax.
examples.zh: 我只想躺在泳池边放松一下。

examples.en: The weather isn't warm enough to play in the pool.
examples.zh: 天气还不够暖和，不能在水池里玩。

examples.en: There is a pile of books on the library desk.
examples.zh: 图书馆的桌子上有一堆书。

examples.en: He left a pile of dirty clothes on the floor.
examples.zh: 他把一堆脏衣服留在地板上。

examples.en: The workers moved the big pile of sand away from the road.
examples.zh: 工人们把一大堆沙子从路上移走了。

examples.en: She wore a black hat upon her head.
examples.zh: 她头上戴着一顶黑色的帽子。

examples.en: We must put great emphasis upon safety.
examples.zh: 我们必须高度重视安全。
