examples.en: Please report to the desk upon your arrival.
examples.zh: 你一到就请到前台报到。

examples.en: The harvest will come soon.
examples.zh: 收割的时刻很快就要到了。

examples.en: Farmers say they have a bumper harvest this year.
examples.zh: 农民们说今年他们有一个大丰收。

examples.en: We got a good harvest this year.
examples.zh: 今年我们获得了好收成。

examples.en: Coffee and rice are their main crops for selling abroad.
examples.zh: 咖啡和稻米是他们出口的主要庄稼。

examples.en: They had a bumper potato crop this year.
examples.zh: 今年他们土豆大丰收。

examples.en: Three bad crops in a row made people face hunger.
examples.zh: 连续三次庄稼歉收让人们面临饥饿。

examples.en: Please preheat the oven to a temperature of 200℃.
examples.zh: 请把烤箱预热到200摄氏度的温度。

examples.en: The temperature has gone up these days, so it's warmer.
examples.zh: 这几天温度上升了，所以更暖和了。

examples.en: The doctor checked him and took his temperature.
examples.zh: 医生给他做了检查，并量了他的体温。

examples.en: They sat on the sofa to watch the movie.
examples.zh: 他们坐在沙发上看电影。

examples.en: The kids sat together on the sofa watching TV.
examples.zh: 孩子们一起坐在沙发上看电视。

examples.en: I sat on the sofa beside Barbara.
examples.zh: 我坐在芭芭拉旁边的沙发上。

examples.en: Do you build a snowman with your friends?
examples.zh: 你和朋友们一起堆雪人吗？

examples.en: The kids make a big snowman in the yard.
examples.zh: 孩子们在院子里堆了一个大雪人。

examples.en: We played with the snowman and had fun.
examples.zh: 我们和雪人一起玩，玩得很开心。

examples.en: The strong wind blew my hat away, so I ran to catch it.
examples.zh: 大风把我的帽子吹走了，所以我跑去追它。

examples.en: The big storm blew down the old fence in our yard.
examples.zh: 大风暴把我们院子的旧栅栏吹倒了。

examples.en: The wind blew harder and harder as the night came.
examples.zh: 夜幕降临时，风越吹越猛。

examples.en: Is that light shining in your eyes?
examples.zh: 那道光是在照你的眼睛吗？

examples.en: The sun shone all afternoon.
examples.zh: 太阳照耀了整个下午。

examples.en: He polished the brass until it shone.
examples.zh: 他把黄铜擦得闪闪发光。

examples.en: My hands smell like onions.
examples.zh: 我的手闻起来有洋葱味。

examples.en: That cake smells nice and sweet.
examples.zh: 那个蛋糕闻起来又香又甜。

examples.en: Something in the fridge smells bad.
examples.zh: 冰箱里有东西闻起来坏了。

examples.en: The heat of the sun makes us feel hot.
examples.zh: 太阳的热量让我们感到热。

examples.en: How can you work in this heat without AC?
examples.zh: 没有空调，你怎么能在这么热的天工作？

examples.en: She wore a coat even in the summer heat.
examples.zh: 即使在夏天的炎热中，她也穿着外套。

examples.en: Don't move suddenly. Put your hands up.
examples.zh: 不要突然动。把手举起来。

examples.en: He had a sudden heart problem on holiday.
examples.zh: 他在度假时突然心脏出了问题。

examples.en: They told us the news, and it was very sudden.
examples.zh: 他们告诉我们这个消息，太突然了。

examples.en: I asked for a few drinks, and it snowballed into a big party.
examples.zh: 我提议喝几杯，结果它滚雪球般变成了一场大派对。

examples.en: People's support for the war snowballed quickly.
examples.zh: 人们对战争的支持迅速滚雪球般增大了。

examples.en: Problems started in April, and then they snowballed.
examples.zh: 问题从四月开始，然后它们滚雪球般变大了。

examples.en: Fog and snow are common here in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天这里常有大雾和雪。

examples.en: Thick fog made driving very dangerous.
examples.zh: 浓雾使开车变得非常危险。

examples.en: Their flight was cancelled because of heavy fog.
examples.zh: 由于大雾，他们的航班被取消了。

examples.en: At the end of class, please divide into groups of four.
examples.zh: 下课之前，请你们分成四人一组。

examples.en: The big cake was divided into eight small parts.
examples.zh: 这个大蛋糕被分成了八小块。

examples.en: Let's divide the work among all of us.
examples.zh: 让我们把工作分给我们所有人。

examples.en: The teacher divides the class into four groups.
examples.zh: 老师把班级分成四个小组。

examples.en: We divided the apple into two halves.
examples.zh: 我们把苹果分成了两半。

examples.en: She divided the paper into three parts.
examples.zh: 她把纸分成了三部分。

examples.en: This rope has a hook at one end and a ring at the other.
examples.zh: 这根绳子一端有钩子，另一端有环。

examples.en: We broke the end of the table when we carried it.
examples.zh: 我们搬桌子时弄坏了桌子的一头。

examples.en: Please go to the end of the line and wait for your turn.
examples.zh: 请到队伍末尾排队，和大家一样等着轮到你。

examples.en: A small town lay beyond the river.
examples.zh: 一个小镇坐落在河的那一边。

examples.en: We could see our house and the woods beyond from the hill.
examples.zh: 从山上我们能看见我们的房子和远处的树林。

examples.en: The path goes beyond the end of the road.
examples.zh: 这条小路延伸到了路的尽头以外。

examples.en: Can I connect my printer to your computer?
examples.zh: 我可以把打印机连接到你的电脑上吗？

examples.en: Where does the stove connect to the electricity?
examples.zh: 炉子在哪里接通电源？

examples.en: Is the internet connected in your new home yet?
examples.zh: 你的新家接通网络了吗？

examples.en: My headache may be connected with the bad weather.
examples.zh: 我的头疼可能和坏天气有关。

examples.en: His success is connected with hard work.
examples.zh: 他的成功与努力学习有关。

examples.en: The noise was connected with the broken machine.
examples.zh: 这噪音和坏掉的机器有关。

examples.en: Keep a positive attitude in your study.
examples.zh: 在学习中保持积极的态度。

examples.en: The good news is that the market is getting positive again.
examples.zh: 好消息是市场又开始积极起来了。

examples.en: East and West have had positive changes in the last ten years.
examples.zh: 东西方在过去十年里有了积极的变化。

examples.en: The big storm had a bad effect on the city.
examples.zh: 大风暴对城市产生了不好的影响。

examples.en: I took medicine for my cold, but it had no effect.
examples.zh: 我吃了治感冒的药，但没起什么效果。

examples.en: I feel the bad effects of sleeping too little.
examples.zh: 我感受到了睡眠太少带来的坏影响。

examples.en: The average of 7, 12, and 20 is 13.
examples.zh: 7、12和20的平均数是13。

examples.en: Prices went up by an average of four percent last year.
examples.zh: 去年物价平均上涨了百分之四。

examples.en: My pay changes, but I make about 175 dollars a day on average.
examples.zh: 我的薪水有变化，但平均每天大约挣175美元。

examples.en: The floor is wet after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后地板是湿的。

examples.en: Don't bring your wet umbrella inside.
examples.zh: 别把你湿伞带进屋里。

examples.en: Her hair is wet because she just swam.
examples.zh: 她的头发湿了，因为她刚游过泳。

examples.en: Colors look better in daylight.
examples.zh: 在日光下，颜色看起来更好。

examples.en: Daylight came into the room through the window.
examples.zh: 日光透过窗户照进房间。

examples.en: The strong daylight made his eyes hurt.
examples.zh: 强烈的日光让他的眼睛感到疼痛。

examples.en: This job needs a high degree of skill.
examples.zh: 这份工作需要很高的技能。

examples.en: There is no degree of doubt about his innocence.
examples.zh: 对于他的清白，没有任何程度的怀疑。

examples.en: I must warn you: there's a degree of danger here.
examples.zh: 我必须警告你：这里有一定程度的危险。

examples.en: On average, we spend two hours on homework every day.
examples.zh: 平均来说，我们每天花两个小时做作业。

examples.en: She reads three books on average each month.
examples.zh: 她平均每个月读三本书。

examples.en: On average, it takes me ten minutes to walk to school.
examples.zh: 平均来说，我步行到学校要花十分钟。

examples.en: The kids played outside in the warm sunshine.
examples.zh: 孩子们在温暖的阳光下在外面玩耍。

examples.en: Butterflies flew around happily in the sunshine.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶在阳光下快乐地飞来飞去。

examples.en: The newly painted house looked nice in the sunshine.
examples.zh: 新刷过的房子在阳光下看起来很好看。

examples.en: When do you start your new class?
examples.zh: 你什么时候开始上新班？

examples.en: We'll start at six o'clock.
examples.zh: 我们六点开始。

examples.en: Can you start on Monday?
examples.zh: 你能周一开工吗？

examples.en: A snowstorm can be very strong and dangerous.
examples.zh: 雪暴可能非常强烈且危险。

examples.en: After a snowstorm, avalanches often happen when it gets warm or windy.
examples.zh: 雪暴过后，天气变暖或有风时，雪崩经常发生。

examples.en: They couldn't find the safe way because of the snowstorm, so they stayed under the trees.
examples.zh: 因为雪暴他们找不到安全的路，所以他们待在树下。

examples.en: He got awful injuries in the car crash.
examples.zh: 他在车祸中受了重伤。

examples.en: We had awful weather today.
examples.zh: 今天天气糟透了。

examples.en: She has an awful boss at work.
examples.zh: 她工作上有个很讨厌的老板。

examples.en: The waiter asked, "Can I take your order now?"
examples.zh: 服务员问：“现在可以帮您点餐了吗？”

examples.en: I want to place an order for a big table.
examples.zh: 我想订购一张大桌子。

examples.en: The email told me my order was sent.
examples.zh: 邮件告诉我，我的订单已经发货了。

examples.en: Please take care of your little brother today.
examples.zh: 今天请照顾好你的小弟弟。

examples.en: Take care when you cross the busy street.
examples.zh: 过繁忙街道时要小心。

examples.en: She takes care of her grandmother every weekend.
examples.zh: 她每个周末都照顾她的奶奶。

examples.en: They skated on the frozen lake.
examples.zh: 他们在结冰的湖上滑冰。

examples.en: The river is frozen solid for weeks in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天河水结冰好几周。

examples.en: We went out in the frozen weather.
examples.zh: 我们在冰冻的天气里出去了。

examples.en: The rope is thick and strong.
examples.zh: 这根绳子又粗又结实。

examples.en: There is a thick layer of dust on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌子上有一层厚厚的灰尘。

examples.en: She read a thick book aloud.
examples.zh: 她大声读了一本厚厚的书。

examples.en: The well is deep, so we can't see the bottom.
examples.zh: 这口井很深，所以我们看不到底。

examples.en: Don't swim in the deep river. It's dangerous.
examples.zh: 别在深的河里游泳。很危险。

examples.en: He got a deep cut on his arm and needed a doctor.
examples.zh: 他胳膊上有个很深的伤口，需要看医生。

examples.en: My friend threw the ball back over the fence.
examples.zh: 我的朋友把球扔回了栅栏那边。

examples.en: He threw his coat over the back of the chair.
examples.zh: 他把外套扔在了椅背上。

examples.en: The horse jumped, and the rider was thrown off.
examples.zh: 马跳了起来，骑手被甩了下来。

examples.en: Tom teaches sculpture at a local school.
examples.zh: 汤姆在当地一所学校教雕塑。

examples.en: The museum has some big sculptures of people.
examples.zh: 博物馆有一些大型人物雕像。

examples.en: This tall sculpture is her new work.
examples.zh: 这座高大的雕塑是她的新作品。

examples.en: The reef has over 1500 sea animals and 400 kinds of coral.
examples.zh: 这片礁石上有超过1500种海洋动物和400种珊瑚。

examples.en: Cold-water corals grow slowly and make weak, net-like shapes.
examples.zh: 冷水珊瑚长得慢，形成脆弱的网状形状。

examples.en: She wears a pretty coral necklace to school.
examples.zh: 她戴着一条漂亮的珊瑚项链去上学。

examples.en: The ship hit a dangerous reef near the shore.
examples.zh: 船在岸边附近撞上了危险的暗礁。

examples.en: Many colorful fish live in the coral reef.
examples.zh: 许多彩色的鱼生活在珊瑚礁里。

examples.en: We learned some new collocations with the word reef.
examples.zh: 我们学了一些和“礁”这个词搭配的新短语。

examples.en: When do they give food to the penguins at the zoo?
examples.zh: 他们什么时候在动物园喂企鹅？

examples.en: People often mix up puffins and penguins.
examples.zh: 人们经常把海鹦和企鹅搞混。

examples.en: About half of the birds in Antarctica are penguins.
examples.zh: 南极大约有一半的鸟是企鹅。

examples.en: Pollution can badly hurt the balanced ecosystem.
examples.zh: 污染会严重伤害平衡的生态系统。

examples.en: Scientists worry these crabs may break the ocean ecosystem.
examples.zh: 科学家担心这些螃蟹可能会破坏海洋生态系统。

examples.en: Forests and reefs are important ecosystems on Earth.
examples.zh: 森林和珊瑚礁是地球上重要的生态系统。

examples.en: A hot climate can make people feel tired.
examples.zh: 炎热的气候会让人感到疲惫。

examples.en: The warm climate here is good for growing oranges.
examples.zh: 这里温暖的气候适合种橙子。

examples.en: After retiring, they plan to live in a warmer climate.
examples.zh: 退休后，他们打算住在更暖和的气候地区。

examples.en: Coastal wetlands are important for birds and plants.
examples.zh: 沿海湿地对于鸟类和植物很重要。

examples.en: Our study used a simple way to check the health of coastal wetlands.
examples.zh: 我们的研究用简单的方法来检查沿海湿地的健康状况。

examples.en: A constructed wetland can help clean water and needs less space.
examples.zh: 人工湿地可以帮助净化水，而且需要更少的空间。

examples.en: The price includes tax and service.
examples.zh: 这个价格包括税费和服务费。

examples.en: Tax and service are included in the price.
examples.zh: 税费和服务费都包含在价格里了。

examples.en: My job includes making calls for him.
examples.zh: 我的工作包括替他打电话。

examples.en: Old tree bark has a thick coat of non-living cells.
examples.zh: 老树皮有一层厚厚的非生物细胞。

examples.en: Tables and rocks are nonliving things without minds.
examples.zh: 桌子和岩石是没有思想的非生物。

examples.en: Bone has living tissue and nonliving matter like minerals.
examples.zh: 骨头有活组织和非生物物质，比如矿物质。

examples.en: There are many ducks in the pond.
examples.zh: 池塘里有很多鸭子。

examples.en: My grandparents have a small garden pond.
examples.zh: 我祖父母有一个小花园池塘。

examples.en: It's nice to see the pond from the other side.
examples.zh: 从另一边看这个池塘很不错。

examples.en: We sat around the table and talked.
examples.zh: 我们围着桌子坐着聊天。

examples.en: He put his arm around her shoulder.
examples.zh: 他用手臂搂着她的肩膀。

examples.en: People stood around the accident place.
examples.zh: 人们围站在事故现场周围。

examples.en: Can you hold my bag while I open the door?
examples.zh: 我开门的时候，你能帮我拿着包吗？

examples.en: He is holding a toy gun in his hand.
examples.zh: 他手里拿着一把玩具枪。

examples.en: The girl held her mom's hand and walked slowly.
examples.zh: 女孩拉着妈妈的手慢慢地走。

examples.en: We must get rid of the old books in our classroom.
examples.zh: 我们必须清除教室里的旧书。

examples.en: She got rid of her bad habit of eating too much candy.
examples.zh: 她摆脱了吃太多糖果的坏习惯。

examples.en: Please get rid of the rubbish before the teacher comes.
examples.zh: 请在老师来之前把垃圾清理掉。

examples.en: Please label your bags to prevent confusion.
examples.zh: 请给你的包贴上标签，以防混淆。

examples.en: His disability prevents him from driving.
examples.zh: 他的残疾使他不能开车。

examples.en: Vaccines can prevent the disease from spreading.
examples.zh: 疫苗能防止疾病传播。

examples.en: If you don't like what you bought, you can take it back to our store for a refund.
examples.zh: 如果你不喜欢买的东西，你可以把它拿回我们的商店退款。

examples.en: His new clothes are shown in all the big stores in London.
examples.zh: 他的新衣服在伦敦所有的大商店里展出。

examples.en: More competition may make the company close some stores this year.
examples.zh: 更多的竞争可能会让公司今年关闭一些商店。

examples.en: Sponge the mud with a wet cloth, and it will go away.
examples.zh: 用湿布擦一下泥，它就会消失。

examples.en: He is sponging off his parents for money.
examples.zh: 他靠向父母要钱过日子。

examples.en: Sponge the shirt with some soap, and the stain will come off.
examples.zh: 用肥皂擦一下衬衫，污渍就会去掉。

examples.en: Don't be silly. You are acting like a child!
examples.zh: 别犯傻。你表现得像个孩子！

examples.en: He acted as if he didn't know me.
examples.zh: 他表现得好像不认识我。

examples.en: The kids acted well at grandma's yesterday.
examples.zh: 孩子们昨天在奶奶家表现很好。

examples.en: His kidneys are failing fast.
examples.zh: 他的肾脏正在快速衰竭。

examples.en: We had steak and kidney pie for lunch.
examples.zh: 我们午餐吃了牛排腰子派。

examples.en: Her kidneys failed, so she got a blood transfusion.
examples.zh: 她的肾脏衰竭了，所以接受了输血。

examples.en: My last haircut was nearly three months ago.
examples.zh: 我上次理发差不多是三个月前了。

examples.en: I have nearly finished the book you lent me.
examples.zh: 我几乎快读完你借给我的那本书了。

examples.en: She is nearly as tall as her father now.
examples.zh: 她现在差不多和她爸爸一样高了。

examples.en: When we burn things, we release carbon dioxide.
examples.zh: 当我们燃烧东西时，会释放二氧化碳。

examples.en: Plants take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen.
examples.zh: 植物吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气。

examples.en: Carbon dioxide has one carbon atom and two oxygen atoms.
examples.zh: 二氧化碳有一个碳原子和两个氧原子。

examples.en: A rat trap caught a big mouse last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一个捕鼠夹抓住了一只大老鼠。

examples.en: He made a rabbit trap with old wood and rope.
examples.zh: 他用旧木头和绳子做了一个捕兔陷阱。

examples.en: The fox was trapped and could not move its foot.
examples.zh: 狐狸被困住了，脚动不了。

examples.en: These chemicals can be harmful to people with asthma.
examples.zh: 这些化学物质可能对哮喘患者有害。

examples.en: You should protect your skin from the harmful sun.
examples.zh: 你应该保护皮肤免受有害阳光的伤害。

examples.en: Cook food at high heat to kill harmful bacteria.
examples.zh: 用高温烹饪食物以杀死有害细菌。

examples.en: We had no money, therefore we had to stop the project.
examples.zh: 我们没有钱，因此不得不停止这个项目。

examples.en: She was very sad, therefore she was not fully responsible for what she did.
examples.zh: 她非常难过，因此她对自己的行为不完全负责。

examples.en: We are kind and honest, therefore we do not like their bad activities.
examples.zh: 我们善良诚实，因此我们不喜欢他们的不良活动。

examples.en: He has a serious disease in his lung.
examples.zh: 他的肺部得了重病。

examples.en: His lung was hurt and could not work well.
examples.zh: 他的肺受伤了，不能正常工作。

examples.en: Running every day can make your lungs stronger.
examples.zh: 每天跑步能让你的肺更强壮。

examples.en: Please slow down when you drive near the school.
examples.zh: 在学校附近开车时请减速。

examples.en: The heavy rain slowed down our trip.
examples.zh: 大雨使我们的行程慢了下来。

examples.en: You should slow down and rest for a while.
examples.zh: 你应该放慢节奏，休息一会儿。

examples.en: She said sadly, "He is away for six months."
examples.zh: 她悲伤地说：“他要离开六个月了。”

examples.en: All her friends will sadly miss her.
examples.zh: 她所有的朋友都会难过地想念她。

examples.en: She said sadly, "I just miss him."
examples.zh: 她悲伤地说：“我就是想他。”

examples.en: We have tons of food after the party.
examples.zh: 聚会后我们有很多食物。

examples.en: Police found about a ton of drugs in the truck.
examples.zh: 警察在卡车里发现了大约一吨毒品。

examples.en: The big rock weighed a ton and couldn't move.
examples.zh: 那块大石头重达一吨，根本动不了。

examples.en: I didn't mean to harm anyone.
examples.zh: 我不是故意要伤害任何人。

examples.en: Missing a meal sometimes never harms you.
examples.zh: 偶尔少吃一顿饭对你没有害处。

examples.en: Such a mistake will harm his reputation a lot.
examples.zh: 这样的错误会大大损害他的名声。

examples.en: We watched a documentary about Peruvian wildlife.
examples.zh: 我们看了一部关于秘鲁野生生物的纪录片。

examples.en: Wildlife groups help protect animals in nature.
examples.zh: 野生生物组织帮助保护自然中的动物。

examples.en: The museum showed a model of local wildlife.
examples.zh: 博物馆展示了一个本地野生生物的模型。

examples.en: We talked about topics like acid rain and melting ice.
examples.zh: 我们谈到了酸雨和融冰之类的话题。

examples.en: You can write about any topic you like.
examples.zh: 你可以写任何你喜欢的话题。

examples.en: She found it hard to stay on topic in her essays.
examples.zh: 她发现写作文很难不跑题。

examples.en: I have quite a few friends in my new school.
examples.zh: 我在新学校有相当多的朋友。

examples.en: She spent quite a few hours on her math homework.
examples.zh: 她花了不少时间做数学作业。

examples.en: There are quite a few books on the shelf.
examples.zh: 书架上有很多书。

examples.en: The noisy fans made us feel excited.
examples.zh: 吵闹的粉丝们让我们感到兴奋。

examples.en: My noisy neighbors always play music at night.
examples.zh: 我吵闹的邻居总在晚上放音乐。

examples.en: The noisy sirens were too loud on the street.
examples.zh: 街上响亮的警笛声太吵了。

examples.en: Our school has a new sound system.
examples.zh: 我们学校有一套新的音响系统。

examples.en: The computer system stopped working again.
examples.zh: 这个电脑系统又停止工作了。

examples.en: Your body's immune system fights off colds.
examples.zh: 你身体的免疫系统可以抵抗感冒。

examples.en: The police still want to find the cause of the fire.
examples.zh: 警察仍然想找出火灾的原因。

examples.en: She died of natural causes.
examples.zh: 她是自然死亡。

examples.en: I won't tell you without cause.
examples.zh: 没有理由我不会告诉你。

examples.en: The storm damaged many houses badly.
examples.zh: 暴风雨严重损坏了许多房屋。

examples.en: The bad news damaged his good name.
examples.zh: 这个坏消息损害了他的好名声。

examples.en: Smoking can damage your health forever.
examples.zh: 吸烟会永久损害你的健康。

examples.en: The wind often comes from the north-east in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天风经常从东北方向吹来。

examples.en: My uncle lives in the north-east of China.
examples.zh: 我叔叔住在中国东北部。

examples.en: We walked north-east along the small river.
examples.zh: 我们沿着小河向东北方向走。

examples.en: The light was too bright, so I covered my eyes.
examples.zh: 光线太亮了，所以我遮住了眼睛。

examples.en: Snow covered the hills last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚雪覆盖了小山。

examples.en: She covered him with a warm blanket.
examples.zh: 她用一条温暖的毯子盖在他身上。

examples.en: This is a rare bird in our city.
examples.zh: 这种鸟在我们城市很稀有。

examples.en: The old museum has many rare things.
examples.zh: 这家老博物馆里有很多珍贵的东西。

examples.en: We got a rare chance to see the great show.
examples.zh: 我们得到了一个难得的机会去看那场精彩的演出。

examples.en: The red-crowned crane has a bright red crown on its head.
examples.zh: 丹顶鹤的头上有一个鲜红色的冠。

examples.en: We saw a red-crowned crane standing by the lake.
examples.zh: 我们看见一只丹顶鹤站在湖边。

examples.en: The red-crowned crane is a symbol of good luck in China.
examples.zh: 丹顶鹤在中国是幸运的象征。

examples.en: We need an assistant to stay for six months.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个助理待六个月。

examples.en: Please stay until the rain stops.
examples.zh: 请待到雨停。

examples.en: Can you stay after work to play tennis?
examples.zh: 你下班后能留下来打网球吗？

examples.en: I often sleep in the daytime and study at night.
examples.zh: 我经常白天睡觉，晚上学习。

examples.en: She hardly saw her family during the daytime.
examples.zh: 她白天几乎见不到家人。

examples.en: He has a regular job in the daytime.
examples.zh: 他白天有一份固定的工作。

examples.en: We chose the right person to lead the trip.
examples.zh: 我们选对了领队的人。

examples.en: I asked Gemma to lead the talk.
examples.zh: 我请吉玛来主持讨论。

examples.en: Who will lead the look into the accident?
examples.zh: 谁来负责调查这次事故？

examples.en: Eating too much candy can lead to toothaches.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖果会导致牙疼。

examples.en: Hard work always leads to good grades.
examples.zh: 努力学习总能带来好成绩。

examples.en: The heavy rain led to a big flood.
examples.zh: 大雨导致了一场大洪水。

examples.en: The cars were stuck in the thick mud.
examples.zh: 汽车陷在厚厚的泥浆里了。

examples.en: People now live in new houses, not old mud huts.
examples.zh: 人们现在住新房子，不住旧泥屋了。

examples.en: He walked slowly through the mud to open the gate.
examples.zh: 他慢慢走过泥地，去打开大门。

examples.en: Charles Schulz created Snoopy and Charlie Brown.
examples.zh: 查尔斯·舒尔茨创造了史努比和查理·布朗。

examples.en: The Bible says God created the world.
examples.zh: 《圣经》说上帝创造了世界。

examples.en: He created a great meal from only a few things.
examples.zh: 他只用很少的东西就做出一顿美餐。

examples.en: We set up a new club in our school last week.
examples.zh: 上周我们在学校建立了一个新俱乐部。

examples.en: They set up a tent by the river for the picnic.
examples.zh: 他们在河边搭起了一个帐篷，准备野餐。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to set up a study group.
examples.zh: 老师让我们成立一个学习小组。

examples.en: The news show was proud of its balanced reporting.
examples.zh: 这个新闻节目以它的平衡报道为傲。

examples.en: The team is balanced, with six players from each side.
examples.zh: 这个团队是平衡的，每边有六名队员。

examples.en: Pollution can hurt the balanced nature of the environment.
examples.zh: 污染会伤害环境的平衡状态。

examples.en: Her knowledge of English grammar is very wide.
examples.zh: 她的英语语法知识很广。

examples.en: He has only a little knowledge of French.
examples.zh: 他只有一点点法语知识。

examples.en: The story is common knowledge to most people.
examples.zh: 这个故事对大多数人来说是常识。

examples.en: The factory pumped fuel for 101 days before workers found the wastewater pipe leak.
examples.zh: 工厂抽了101天燃料，之后工人们才发现废水管道泄漏。

examples.en: Workers didn't notice the wastewater leak until they checked the pipes after 101 days.
examples.zh: 工人们直到101天后检查管道才发现废水泄漏。

examples.en: The wastewater pipe leaked for 101 days before anyone found the problem.
examples.zh: 废水管道泄漏了101天，才有人发现问题。

examples.en: We use environment-friendly bags to protect the Earth.
examples.zh: 我们用环保袋来保护地球。

examples.en: This car is environment-friendly because it uses clean energy.
examples.zh: 这辆车是环保的，因为它使用清洁能源。

examples.en: My school encourages students to buy environment-friendly products.
examples.zh: 我们学校鼓励学生购买环保产品。

examples.en: Excuse me, sir, can you tell me the time?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，先生，您能告诉我现在几点吗？

examples.en: Sir, please sign your name here.
examples.zh: 先生，请在这里签上您的名字。

examples.en: Thank you, sir, for helping me with my bag.
examples.zh: 谢谢您，先生，帮我拿包。

examples.en: Can I help you with your bags, Madam?
examples.zh: 女士，我能帮您拿包吗？

examples.en: Dear Madam, I write for your uncle, Mr James Ross.
examples.zh: 亲爱的女士，我替您的叔叔詹姆斯·罗斯先生写信。

examples.en: She acts like a little madam now.
examples.zh: 她现在表现得像个小公主。

examples.en: Her parents died in a plane crash and were killed.
examples.zh: 她的父母在飞机失事中丧生。

examples.en: Smoking can kill you slowly.
examples.zh: 吸烟会慢慢杀死你。

examples.en: Heat the food to kill bad bacteria.
examples.zh: 加热食物以杀死有害细菌。

examples.en: We need to solve this math problem together.
examples.zh: 我们需要一起解决这道数学题。

examples.en: Can you solve the puzzle in five minutes?
examples.zh: 你能在五分钟内解开这个谜题吗？

examples.en: Don't cry. Crying won't solve your problem.
examples.zh: 别哭。哭解决不了你的问题。

examples.en: People now care more about environmental problems.
examples.zh: 人们现在更关心环境问题了。

examples.en: This factory causes several environmental diseases.
examples.zh: 这家工厂导致了几种环境疾病。

examples.en: Plastic waste is a big environmental hazard.
examples.zh: 塑料垃圾是一个很大的环境危害。

examples.en: They could hear the sound of a bell far away.
examples.zh: 他们能听到远处传来的钟声。

examples.en: She stood still and made no sound.
examples.zh: 她站着不动，没发出一点声音。

examples.en: Suddenly we heard a loud sound from the engine.
examples.zh: 突然我们听到引擎发出很大的声音。

examples.en: After the heavy rain, all the students came back safe and sound.
examples.zh: 大雨过后，所有学生都安然无恙地回来了。

examples.en: The lost cat was found safe and sound under the old tree.
examples.zh: 走失的猫在老树下被找到了，安然无恙。

examples.en: Don't worry, mom. I arrived at school safe and sound.
examples.zh: 别担心，妈妈。我平安到校了。

examples.en: In an emergency, how can disabled people get out?
examples.zh: 在紧急情况下，残疾人怎么出去？

examples.en: Can wheelchairs use the emergency exit?
examples.zh: 轮椅能用紧急出口吗？

examples.en: The pilot had to make an emergency landing on the lake.
examples.zh: 飞行员不得不在湖上紧急降落。

examples.en: The economic situation is getting better now.
examples.zh: 现在的经济情况正在好转。

examples.en: Her news made my situation very difficult.
examples.zh: 她的消息让我的处境变得很困难。

examples.en: Would you join a fight? It depends on the situation.
examples.zh: 你会加入打架吗？那要看情况而定。

examples.en: Is the heating on now?
examples.zh: 现在供暖开着吗？

examples.en: When does the heating start in the morning?
examples.zh: 早上供暖什么时候开始？

examples.en: It's so hot here, can we turn down the heating?
examples.zh: 这里太热了，我们能调低供暖吗？

examples.en: The thunder and lightning moved away, but it still rained hard.
examples.zh: 雷声和闪电远去了，但雨仍下得很大。

examples.en: A flash of lightning made the sky bright.
examples.zh: 一道闪电照亮了天空。

examples.en: Lightning hit our school yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天闪电击中了我们的学校。

examples.en: The director's office is on the second floor.
examples.zh: 主任的办公室在二楼。

examples.en: Last night, I stayed in the office until eight.
examples.zh: 昨晚我在办公室待到八点。

examples.en: We bought some new office equipment yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们昨天买了一些新的办公设备。

examples.en: We must find homes for many homeless families.
examples.zh: 我们必须为许多无家可归的家庭找到住处。

examples.en: She was homeless, so she let others adopt her child.
examples.zh: 她无家可归，所以让别人收养了她的孩子。

examples.en: The family became homeless after the fire.
examples.zh: 火灾后，这家人变得无家可归。

examples.en: She is a tennis coach at our school.
examples.zh: 她是我们学校的网球教练。

examples.en: The head coach named Gus Poyet got the job.
examples.zh: 主教练古斯·波耶特得到了这份工作。

examples.en: The coach said all players must come to morning practice.
examples.zh: 教练说所有队员都必须来参加晨练。

examples.en: We live on a busy road with many cars.
examples.zh: 我们住在一条车很多的繁忙道路上。

examples.en: Be careful when you cross the main road.
examples.zh: 过主干道时要小心。

examples.en: There is a coffee shop across the road.
examples.zh: 马路对面有一家咖啡店。

examples.en: Josh had an accident and spilled water on his work.
examples.zh: 乔希出了个意外，把水洒在了他的作业上。

examples.en: The truck was in an accident.
examples.zh: 那辆卡车出事故了。

examples.en: The sign was broken in an accident.
examples.zh: 这个标志牌在事故中损坏了。

examples.en: The big ship sank in a typhoon in the South China Sea.
examples.zh: 那艘大船在南海的一次台风中沉没了。

examples.en: Many people left the coast before the typhoon came.
examples.zh: 许多人在台风来临前离开了海岸。

examples.en: The typhoon destroyed some small houses near the sea.
examples.zh: 台风摧毁了海边的一些小房子。

examples.en: The weather was really terrible yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天天气真的很糟糕。

examples.en: We just got some terrible news from him.
examples.zh: 我们刚从他那儿得到一些可怕的消息。

examples.en: If the weather is terrible, we'll do something else.
examples.zh: 如果天气很糟，我们就做别的事情。

examples.en: The old house was in a bad state, so they fixed it.
examples.zh: 这栋老房子状况很差，所以他们把它修好了。

examples.en: He was in a happy state of mind after the game.
examples.zh: 比赛后他心情很好。

examples.en: Don't drive now — you are not in a good state.
examples.zh: 现在别开车——你的状态不好。

examples.en: Firemen saved a few minutes to stop the fire before it got big.
examples.zh: 消防员抢出了几分钟，在大火变大前把它扑灭了。

examples.en: Firemen ran in and out of the house, carrying furniture out with the boys.
examples.zh: 消防员和男孩们跑进跑出，把家具搬出房子。

examples.en: Firemen worked hard to put out the fire and stop it from spreading.
examples.zh: 消防员努力工作，扑灭大火并阻止它蔓延。

examples.en: There was heavy traffic on the roads this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上路上交通很拥挤。

examples.en: We were stuck in traffic for two hours.
examples.zh: 我们堵车堵了两个小时。

examples.en: The city is trying new ways to reduce traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 这个城市正在尝试新方法来减少交通堵塞。

examples.en: The students made a slight improvement in English.
examples.zh: 学生们在英语上有了轻微的进步。

examples.en: There is a slight incline at the end of the road.
examples.zh: 这条路尽头有一个轻微的斜坡。

examples.en: She felt a slight headache after the long walk.
examples.zh: 长途步行后，她感到轻微的头痛。

examples.en: The boy shook the apple tree, and the apples fell down.
examples.zh: 男孩摇了摇苹果树，苹果就掉下来了。

examples.en: Babies like toys that make noise when shaken.
examples.zh: 婴儿喜欢摇起来会响的玩具。

examples.en: The big bang shook buildings nearby.
examples.zh: 巨大的爆炸震动了附近的建筑物。

examples.en: We heard a loud clap of thunder.
examples.zh: 我们听到一声响亮的雷声。

examples.en: Thunder and lightning come before the rain.
examples.zh: 雷和闪电在雨前到来。

examples.en: The thunder of the waterfall was too loud to hear him.
examples.zh: 瀑布的轰鸣声太响，我听不见他说话。

examples.en: The enemy dropped many bombs on the city during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间，敌人在这个城市投下了许多炸弹。

examples.en: A big bomb went off in a market and hurt three people today.
examples.zh: 今天一颗大炸弹在市场爆炸，伤了三个人。

examples.en: A bomb exploded near a hospital in Baghdad.
examples.zh: 一颗炸弹在巴格达一家医院附近爆炸了。

examples.en: Don't shout, I can hear you well.
examples.zh: 别喊，我能听清你说话。

examples.en: Eleni shouted, "See you tomorrow!" over the noise.
examples.zh: 埃莱尼在嘈杂声中喊道：“明天见！”

examples.en: He shouted from the garage that he would finish soon.
examples.zh: 他在车库里喊，他马上就干完了。

examples.en: She gave the money to the man with fear in her eyes.
examples.zh: 她眼里带着恐惧，把钱交给了那个男人。

examples.en: The boy didn't show any fear even when the waves got big.
examples.zh: 即使浪变大了，那个男孩也没有表现出任何恐惧。

examples.en: I have a fear of heights, so I don't go near tall buildings.
examples.zh: 我有恐高症，所以我不靠近高楼。

examples.en: She looked at the dog in fear and ran away.
examples.zh: 她恐惧地看着那条狗，然后跑开了。

examples.en: The boy was in fear of telling his parents the bad news.
examples.zh: 这个男孩害怕告诉父母这个坏消息。

examples.en: He walked into the dark room in fear, holding his mother's hand.
examples.zh: 他握着妈妈的手，恐惧地走进黑暗的房间。

examples.en: “No, go that way,” I said, pointing in the opposite direction.
examples.zh: “不，走那边，”我指着相反的方向说。

examples.en: He walked in the direction of his bedroom.
examples.zh: 他朝着卧室的方向走去。

examples.en: They drove away in opposite directions.
examples.zh: 他们朝相反的方向开车离开了。

examples.en: The birds flew in all directions when they heard the noise.
examples.zh: 听到噪音时，鸟儿们向四面八方飞去。

examples.en: People ran in all directions to escape the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 人们向四处跑去躲避大雨。

examples.en: The children looked in all directions for their lost dog.
examples.zh: 孩子们四处寻找他们丢失的狗。

examples.en: We made a small wall with adobe bricks.
examples.zh: 我们用土砖砌了一堵小墙。

examples.en: The old house was built with mud bricks.
examples.zh: 那座老房子是用泥砖建的。

examples.en: Glass bricks let light into the room.
examples.zh: 玻璃砖让光线照进房间。

examples.en: The empty house was very silent.
examples.zh: 那座空房子非常安静。

examples.en: At 4 a.m., the streets were completely silent.
examples.zh: 凌晨四点，街道完全安静。

examples.en: There was a silent tapping at the door.
examples.zh: 门上传来一阵轻轻的敲击声。

examples.en: Do you get nervous during exams?
examples.zh: 考试时你会紧张吗？

examples.en: I always feel nervous before a race.
examples.zh: 比赛前我总是感到紧张。

examples.en: I was too nervous to speak.
examples.zh: 我太紧张了，说不出话来。

examples.en: Simon always beats me in tennis.
examples.zh: 西蒙打网球总是赢我。

examples.en: The Miami Heat beat the Pacers by five points.
examples.zh: 迈阿密热火队赢了步行者队5分。

examples.en: Holland beat Belgium 3-1.
examples.zh: 荷兰队以3比1战胜了比利时队。

examples.en: She said to herself, "I can do it well."
examples.zh: 她暗想：“我能做好这件事。”

examples.en: He said to himself, "It's time to go home."
examples.zh: 他自言自语：“该回家了。”

examples.en: I said to myself, "Don't forget the key."
examples.zh: 我暗想：“别忘了带钥匙。”

examples.en: Everyone, keep calm. The police are coming.
examples.zh: 大家保持冷静，警察快到了。

examples.en: He is usually calm in meetings, but this time he got angry.
examples.zh: 他开会时通常很冷静，但这次他生气了。

examples.en: Please stay calm and leave the building in order.
examples.zh: 请保持冷静，有秩序地离开大楼。

examples.en: Please calm down and tell me what happened.
examples.zh: 请平静下来，告诉我发生了什么事。

examples.en: She took a deep breath to calm down before the test.
examples.zh: 考试前她深吸一口气让自己平静下来。

examples.en: The teacher asked the noisy kids to calm down.
examples.zh: 老师让吵闹的孩子们安静下来。

examples.en: Emma went to work in New York a year ago, and we haven't seen her since.
examples.zh: 艾玛一年前去纽约工作了，从那以后我们就没见过她。

examples.en: He started working there in 1995, and has stayed ever since.
examples.zh: 他1995年开始在那里工作，从那以后一直待在那儿。

examples.en: I learned some Latin, but I've long since forgotten it.
examples.zh: 我学过一些拉丁语，但早就忘了。

examples.en: You feel weak if you don't eat well for days. It's not surprising.
examples.zh: 如果你几天不好好吃饭，你会感到虚弱。这并不奇怪。

examples.en: The field gets weaker when you move far from the cables.
examples.zh: 当你远离电缆时，磁场会变弱。

examples.en: Put weak or breakable things high when kids visit.
examples.zh: 孩子们来玩时，把易碎或脆弱的东西放高处。

examples.en: You have a loud voice. Please don't shout.
examples.zh: 你嗓门真大，请别喊了。

examples.en: He speaks in a quiet voice in class.
examples.zh: 他在课堂上说话声音很小。

examples.en: She sings with a soft, sweet voice.
examples.zh: 她用轻柔甜美的声音唱歌。

examples.en: The museum opens every day except Monday.
examples.zh: 博物馆除周一外每天开放。

examples.en: We have no choice except to wait for the bus.
examples.zh: 除了等公交车，我们别无选择。

examples.en: It is cool and quiet everywhere except in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 除了厨房，到处都凉爽安静。

examples.en: Her clothes smelled of cigarette smoke.
examples.zh: 她的衣服闻起来有香烟味。

examples.en: The smoke-filled bar is no longer popular.
examples.zh: 满是烟雾的酒吧不再受欢迎了。

examples.en: The fire made a large cloud of smoke seen 20 miles away.
examples.zh: 大火产生了一大团烟，二十英里外都能看到。

examples.en: He got badly burned in the big fire.
examples.zh: 他在大火中严重烧伤。

examples.en: She burned his old love letters.
examples.zh: 她烧掉了他的旧情书。

examples.en: Six people were burned alive in the building.
examples.zh: 六个人在大楼里被活活烧死了。

examples.en: The firefighter put out the big fire quickly.
examples.zh: 消防员迅速扑灭了大火。

examples.en: Please put out the candles before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前请把蜡烛熄灭。

examples.en: She put out the campfire with water.
examples.zh: 她用水把营火浇灭了。

examples.en: It rained heavily last night, so the roads were wet.
examples.zh: 昨晚雨下得很大，所以路面湿了。

examples.en: She slept heavily and missed the morning call.
examples.zh: 她睡得很沉，错过了早上的电话。

examples.en: The box is heavily packed with books and papers.
examples.zh: 这个箱子被书和纸塞得满满的。

examples.en: I didn't know the answer, so I had to guess.
examples.zh: 我不知道答案，所以只好猜了。

examples.en: If they guess wrong, they may lose much money.
examples.zh: 如果他们猜错了，可能会损失很多钱。

examples.en: On the last question, she guessed right.
examples.zh: 最后一题，她猜对了。

examples.en: She wears a straw hat on sunny days.
examples.zh: 她在晴天戴一顶草帽。

examples.en: He put on a woolly hat to keep warm.
examples.zh: 他戴上羊毛帽保暖。

examples.en: The woman's wide-brimmed hat blocked the sun.
examples.zh: 那位女士的宽檐帽挡住了阳光。

examples.en: The teacher gave us clear instructions for the homework.
examples.zh: 老师给了我们清晰的作业说明。

examples.en: Please speak more clearly so everyone can hear you.
examples.zh: 请说清楚一点，这样每个人都能听到你。

examples.en: The screen is clear, so we can watch the movie well.
examples.zh: 屏幕很清晰，所以我们可以好好看电影。

examples.en: The young men fought with the policeman and ran away.
examples.zh: 那些年轻人和警察打了起来，然后跑掉了。

examples.en: The policeman used a torch to check every car on the street.
examples.zh: 警察用手电筒检查街上的每辆车。

examples.en: The traffic lights didn't work, so a policeman told cars where to go.
examples.zh: 交通灯坏了，所以一名警察指挥车辆往哪儿走。

examples.en: Old people often have many aches and pains.
examples.zh: 老年人经常会有各种疼痛。

examples.en: I have a dull ache in my lower back.
examples.zh: 我的后腰有点隐隐作痛。

examples.en: Take some medicine to ease the ache.
examples.zh: 吃点药来缓解疼痛。

examples.en: The postman hasn't come yet.
examples.zh: 邮递员还没来。

examples.en: Our dog bit the postman yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我们的狗咬了邮递员。

examples.en: The postman gave me this package for you.
examples.zh: 邮递员把给你的包裹交给了我。

examples.en: Beijing has a big international airport.
examples.zh: 北京有一个大型国际机场。

examples.en: The plane landed at a military airport.
examples.zh: 飞机降落在军用机场。

examples.en: We flew to London and arrived at Gatwick Airport.
examples.zh: 我们飞往伦敦，到达了盖特威克机场。

examples.en: Many refugees came to the border without passports.
examples.zh: 许多难民没有护照就来到了边境。

examples.en: He was a German using a Swiss passport.
examples.zh: 他是个德国人，却拿着瑞士护照。

examples.en: The computer problem slowed things down at passport control.
examples.zh: 电脑故障让护照检查处的工作变慢了。

examples.en: Please close the door. It's cold outside.
examples.zh: 请关上门。外面很冷。

examples.en: I forgot to close the window before leaving.
examples.zh: 我离开前忘了关窗户。

examples.en: Close your eyes and open your mouth.
examples.zh: 闭上你的眼睛，张开你的嘴。

examples.en: We called the insurance company to report the theft.
examples.zh: 我们打电话给保险公司汇报失窃的事。

examples.en: All the newspapers reported the assassination.
examples.zh: 所有报纸都报道了这起暗杀事件。

examples.en: He reported on the company's money situation.
examples.zh: 他汇报了公司的资金状况。

examples.en: The bush fire burned many trees last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天，山林大火烧毁了许多树木。

examples.en: People ran away quickly from the bush fire.
examples.zh: 人们迅速逃离了山林大火。

examples.en: A bush fire can start very easily in dry weather.
examples.zh: 在干燥的天气里，山林大火很容易发生。

examples.en: We have learned 500 words so far.
examples.zh: 迄今为止我们已经学了500个单词。

examples.en: So far, the weather has been fine this week.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，这周的天气一直很好。

examples.en: I have finished two books so far this month.
examples.zh: 这个月到目前为止我已经读完了两本书。

examples.en: Eight people, including two kids, got hurt.
examples.zh: 包括两个孩子在内，八个人受伤了。

examples.en: I have a week off, including Christmas Day.
examples.zh: 我有一个星期的假，包括圣诞节那天。

examples.en: He did bad things, including two killings.
examples.zh: 他做了坏事，包括两起杀人案。

examples.en: Please sign your name on the line.
examples.zh: 请在这条线上签你的名字。

examples.en: She signed the agreement yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天签了那份协议。

examples.en: The sign says no parking here.
examples.zh: 那个标牌上写着这里不能停车。

examples.en: I'm anxious to avoid the busy road at rush hour.
examples.zh: 我急着要避开高峰时段繁忙的马路。

examples.en: I try to avoid supermarkets on Saturdays because they're busy.
examples.zh: 我尽量在周六避开超市，因为那里很挤。

examples.en: Is Lukas avoiding me? I haven't seen him all day.
examples.zh: 卢卡斯是不是在躲我？我一整天都没见到他。

examples.en: He got a gunshot wound in his arm.
examples.zh: 他的手臂上有一处枪伤。

examples.en: The soldier had a leg wound and couldn't walk.
examples.zh: 那个士兵腿部受伤，走不了路。

examples.en: Luckily, it was just a flesh wound, not deep.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，这只是皮肉伤，不深。

examples.en: Your arm is bleeding. Please stop it.
examples.zh: 你的手臂在流血。请止住它。

examples.en: He fell down and was bleeding badly.
examples.zh: 他摔倒了，流血很严重。

examples.en: Don't use wet ink, or the colors will bleed together.
examples.zh: 别用湿墨水，否则颜色会混在一起。

examples.en: Press the button, and the machine will start.
examples.zh: 按下按钮，机器就会启动。

examples.en: He pressed his face on the window to see outside.
examples.zh: 他把脸贴在窗户上往外看。

examples.en: Please press my shoulders a little harder.
examples.zh: 请再用力一点按我的肩膀。

examples.en: Make sure the rope is firmly tied before you climb down.
examples.zh: 在你爬下去之前，确保绳子系紧了。

examples.en: Tighten the clamp until it firmly holds the pipette up.
examples.zh: 拧紧夹子，直到它牢牢地托住吸管。

examples.en: Fix the tent pegs firmly in the ground.
examples.zh: 把帐篷桩牢牢地固定在地里。

examples.en: Please finish your homework right away.
examples.zh: 请马上完成你的作业。

examples.en: We left the classroom right away after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我们立刻离开了教室。

examples.en: If you see a fire, call 119 right away.
examples.zh: 如果你看到火灾，马上拨打119。

examples.en: A tidal wave of complaints hit the office.
examples.zh: 潮水般的投诉涌进了办公室。

examples.en: The boss faced a tidal wave of complaints.
examples.zh: 老板面对了潮水般的投诉。

examples.en: They got a tidal wave of complaints today.
examples.zh: 他们今天收到了潮水般的投诉。

examples.en: We were warned not to eat the fish. It might make us sick.
examples.zh: 我们被警告不要吃那条鱼，它可能会让我们生病。

examples.en: Have you warned them that an extra person will come to dinner?
examples.zh: 你警告过他们会有额外一个人来吃晚饭吗？

examples.en: I was warned against going to the east coast. It was too crowded.
examples.zh: 我被警告不要去东海岸，那里太拥挤了。
